cells.remarks: Hail! Prosperity! The following is engraved from verbal orders received :— This is the edict of Chitraméla who is the son of the illustrious Bhúdéví, and who was sprung from the fourth class (Śúdra), (promulgated) for the benefit of all the world . . . . . In the Śaka year one thousand one hundred and nineteen, the inhabitants of (a number of) nádus (Pédainádu, Péráttinádu, Mungaláṛattainádu, Kadaiyaśinganádu, Pūngainádu, Tongaipúnulñádu, Chakalanádu, Pottappinádu) of Jayānkondachólamaṇdala having all assembled at Chittiramélimaṇdapa in Tiruppáṛkadāṛchittiramélīviṇṇagar, gave to the god at Chittiramélīviṇṇagar, free of tax, lands to the extent of 2,200 kuli . We shall give this (extent of land). He who hinders this will incur the sin of stabbing a tawny cow on the banks of the Ganges. Thus agreeing we have made the gift. (Then follows a list of signatures of those who consented to this grant).
cells.text_original:
[1] வீவீபரீ கிருவாய்க்[ெ] கழ்வி முன்னுடைத்ததாக புரீ-
கீகஹ-ூகெவிவடதுவு வாகடுவுட்ண்டுகடுகெவுவவுட்-
வொகஹிகாது-ாய விதுவேலுப்பாலகு அரம்வளா்க . .
. ப்புகழ்பெருக . . . . . நியாய நடாத்துகின்ற ஜயங்
கொண்டசொழமண்டலத்துப் பெடைநாட்டு இவிஷைய .
. . . . இவிஷையத்தொழும் பொராத்கிநாட்டு வ-
[2] மீ[ர]விஷையத்தொழுங்கலா[ர]மத்தைநாட்டு விஷையத்தொழுங்கடையச்சிங்கநாட்டு விஷையத்தொழு[ம்] பூங்கைநாட்டு விஷையத்தொழுந்தொங்கைப்பூத[ள்]நாட்டு விஷையத்தொழுஞ்சகலநாட்டு விஷையத்தொழும்பெ*த்தப்பிகாட்டு விஷையத்தொ[ம்*] உட்பட்ட பெரியநாட்டு விஷையத்தொம் சகரயாண்டு ஆயிரத்தொருதூற்றொருபத்தொன்பதாவ.-
[3]. (த்)குத்திருப்பாற்கடற் சித்திரமெழிவிண்ணகரிற்சித்திரமெழிமண்டபத்துக்குமைவறக்கூடி நிமைவற நிமைந்திருந்து இச்சித்திரமெழிவிண்ணகரெம்பெருமானுக்கு எங்கள் திருவிடையாட்டமாக வைத்துக்குடுத்த பரிசாவது டெருராள் வை ஆயிரங்குழியும் நல்வுதரத்தாள்கள் எழுதூற்மைம்பதுகுழ்யுஞ்சீற்காள்வை ஐந்தூறுகுழியும் டள்ளிபட.-
[4] இப்படி விடி[த்தார்]பெரிய நாயநார்க்குப்பழைத்தார்பட இது விடக்கடவர்களாகவும் இது விலக்களூர் கெங்கைக்கரைக்குராற்பசுக்குத்தினான் பாவத்தெப்படவாராகவும் இப்படி சம்மதித்து வைத்துக்குடுத்தொம் பெரியநாட்டு விஷையத்தொம் பணியாள் சித்திரமெழிவெனான் எழுத்து இப்படிக்கு இவைகடுவெவிவிஷையசேபைதி எழுத்து இப்படிக்கு
[5] இவை முதிபுறத்துக்கங்கை கொண்டானெழுக்து இப்படிக்கு இவை கண்டநாராயணபுரத்துத்தாமிரட்டகுடி எழுத்து இப் டிக்கு இவைகெரள உருப்பிரட்டகுடி எழுத்து இப்படிக்கு இவை வெங்கூர் சொமிரட்டகுடி எழுத்து இப்படிக்கு இவை அல்லூர் முப்பிட்டகுடி எழுத்து இப்படிக்கு இவை அல்லூர் அயித்தமி.-
[6] ப்படிக்கு இவை விரியூர்ச்சியபயநாயக்கனெழுத்து இப்படிக்கு இவை . . . ப . . . .

text.object: North wall of Ranganáyakala-swámi temple
text.remarks:
Hail! Prosperity! The following is engraved from verbal orders received :—
This is the edict of Chitraméla who is the son of the illustrious Bhúdéví, and who was sprung from the fourth class (Śúdra), (promulgated) for the benefit of all the world . . . . .
In the Śaka year one thousand one hundred and nineteen, the inhabitants of (a number of)  nádus  (Pédainádu, Péráttinádu, Mungaláṛattainádu, Kadaiyaśinganádu, Pūngainádu, Tongaipúnulñádu, Chakalanádu, Pottappinádu) of Jayānkondachólamaṇdala having all assembled at Chittiramélimaṇdapa in Tiruppáṛkadāṛchittiramélīviṇṇagar, gave to the god at Chittiramélīviṇṇagar, free of tax, lands to the extent of 2,200  kuli . We shall give this (extent of land). He who hinders this will incur the sin of stabbing a tawny cow on the banks of the Ganges.
Thus agreeing we have made the gift.
(Then follows a list of signatures of those who consented to this grant).
text.text_original: [1] வீவீபரீ கிருவாய்க்[ெ] கழ்வி முன்னுடைத்ததாக புரீ-கீகஹ-ூகெவிவடதுவு வாகடுவுட்ண்டுகடுகெவுவவுட்-வொகஹிகாது-ாய விதுவேலுப்பாலகு அரம்வளா்க . .. ப்புகழ்பெருக . . . . . நியாய நடாத்துகின்ற ஜயங்கொண்டசொழமண்டலத்துப் பெடைநாட்டு இவிஷைய .. . . . இவிஷையத்தொழும் பொராத்கிநாட்டு வ-[2] மீ[ர]விஷையத்தொழுங்கலா[ர]மத்தைநாட்டு விஷையத்தொழுங்கடையச்சிங்கநாட்டு விஷையத்தொழு[ம்] பூங்கைநாட்டு விஷையத்தொழுந்தொங்கைப்பூத[ள்]நாட்டு விஷையத்தொழுஞ்சகலநாட்டு விஷையத்தொழும்பெ*த்தப்பிகாட்டு விஷையத்தொ[ம்*] உட்பட்ட பெரியநாட்டு விஷையத்தொம் சகரயாண்டு ஆயிரத்தொருதூற்றொருபத்தொன்பதாவ.-[3]. (த்)குத்திருப்பாற்கடற் சித்திரமெழிவிண்ணகரிற்சித்திரமெழிமண்டபத்துக்குமைவறக்கூடி நிமைவற நிமைந்திருந்து இச்சித்திரமெழிவிண்ணகரெம்பெருமானுக்கு எங்கள் திருவிடையாட்டமாக வைத்துக்குடுத்த பரிசாவது டெருராள் வை ஆயிரங்குழியும் நல்வுதரத்தாள்கள் எழுதூற்மைம்பதுகுழ்யுஞ்சீற்காள்வை ஐந்தூறுகுழியும் டள்ளிபட.-[4] இப்படி விடி[த்தார்]பெரிய நாயநார்க்குப்பழைத்தார்பட இது விடக்கடவர்களாகவும் இது விலக்களூர் கெங்கைக்கரைக்குராற்பசுக்குத்தினான் பாவத்தெப்படவாராகவும் இப்படி சம்மதித்து வைத்துக்குடுத்தொம் பெரியநாட்டு விஷையத்தொம் பணியாள் சித்திரமெழிவெனான் எழுத்து இப்படிக்கு இவைகடுவெவிவிஷையசேபைதி எழுத்து இப்படிக்கு[5] இவை முதிபுறத்துக்கங்கை கொண்டானெழுக்து இப்படிக்கு இவை கண்டநாராயணபுரத்துத்தாமிரட்டகுடி எழுத்து இப் டிக்கு இவைகெரள உருப்பிரட்டகுடி எழுத்து இப்படிக்கு இவை வெங்கூர் சொமிரட்டகுடி எழுத்து இப்படிக்கு இவை அல்லூர் முப்பிட்டகுடி எழுத்து இப்படிக்கு இவை அல்லூர் அயித்தமி.-[6] ப்படிக்கு இவை விரியூர்ச்சியபயநாயக்கனெழுத்து இப்படிக்கு இவை . . . ப . . . .

cells.object: From northern wall of Ranganáyakulaswámi temple

cells.text_original:

[1] வையத்தொழும் . . . . . விஷயத்தொழும்
காட்டுவிவையத்தொழுங்கெ . . . படத்பாடு நாட்டுவி-
ஷயத்தொழுங்கடைப . . . . . நாட்டுவிவையத்தொ-
ழுங் . . . . . நாட்டு விஷயத்தொழுங்கடை . . . . .
[2] பிங்குல வப[வொ]வலரத்து மதுரையும் ஈழமுழுங்கொ-ண்டு பாண்டியன் முடித்தலை கொண்டருளின புரீகுலத்துங்க-சொழதெவர்க்கு யாண்டுவிரண்டு(?)பாண்டியன் முடித்தலைகொண்டருளின புரீகுலோத்துங்க சொழதெவர்க்கு யாண்டு பதி-நை[ந்தா]வது வுர ஸ்திகநாயற்றுப்பதி[நாலாந்தி]யதியான வெ-ளளிக்கிழமையும் ரெவதியுமான நாள் இம்மண்டலத்து நெல் ஆரான விக்கிரம்சிங்கபுர . . . . .
[3] இக்கண்ணவை இருதாற்கைம்பது குழியும் நிர்நிலத்-திலெ விட்டு நாலு முலைபிலுந்[த்]திருவாழிமஞ்சித்திரமெழியும் இட்ட கல் நட்டுச்சந்திராதித்தவரை செல்லக்கடவதாக விடக-டவொமாகவும் இப்படி மிவாணபுரசெவகம் விற்றுள்ளன-தெமெழிபிடத்து மக்கடவர் எல்லாமும் விடக்கடவ . . . . . ாகவும் . . . . .
[4] இவை நெல்லூர் உடையான் எழுத்து இப்படிக்கு இவை குறட்டப்பூண்டிப்பிசட்டகுடி எழுத்து இப்படிக்கு இ-வை கொடுவருள் வெளான் எழுத்து இப் . . . . . ண்டிப் பிரட்டகுடி எழுத்து இப்படிக்கு இவை கொடுவருள் வெளர் எழுத்து இப்படிக்கு இவை உருவூர் உலகுய்யாகொண்ட சொ-யத்தரட்டி எழுத்து இப்படிக்கு இவை பூத்தக்கூர் இராயிட்ட-குடி எழுத்து இப்படிக்கு . . . . .

cells.object: Western wall of Ranganáya-kulaswámi temple
cells.remarks: Hail! Prosperity! In the Śaka year 1224 Plavanga (Plava ?) corresponding to the 12th year of the reign of the emperor of the three worlds, the glorious Rájagaṇdagópáladéva, on the date corresponding to Monday with the nakshatra Róhiñi, the tenth day of the bright half of the month of Makara, I, Madurántukapóttapichóla alias Ránganáthan alias Rájagaṇdagópáladéva, gave to last as long as the moon and sun to (the god of) Chitraméliviṇṇagar namely Pallikoṇdaperumál at Tiruppáṛkaḍal in Nellúr alias Vikramaśingapura (situated) in Padainádu in Chédikulamánikkavaḥanádu (a sub-division) of Jayaṇkoṇdachólamandala, for ceremonies including sacred food, ornaments, daily offerings and temple repairs, free of tax and as exclusive property, the dry and wet lands included within the four boundaries of the village of . . . in Padainádu. If there is anybody who obstructs this charity, he will incur the sin of killing of a tawny cow on the banks of the Ganges. doubtless read Plava which is S S. 1224 current. To agree with other inscriptions, however, we ought to have the expired Saka year 1224.
cells.text_original:
[1] ஸ்ஷ் ஸ்ரீ சகரையாண்டு துடாடிசு [பிலவங்க- வகிலசுரி திருவபஙனச்சக்கரவத்திகள் ஸ்ரீ இராசகண்டகொ- பாலதெவற் (க்)கு யாண்டு
[2] பன்னிரண்டாவது மகரநாயற்று பூலு-பக்ஷத்து உரு- மியும் திங்கட்சிழமையும் பெற்ற உரொசணிநாள் மதுராந்- தக—
[3] ப்பொத்தப்பிச்சொழன் ரெங்கநாதன். ஆன இராசகண்- டகொபாலதெவனென் செயங்கொண்டசொழ-
[4] மண்டலத்துச்செதிகுலமாணிக்கவளநாட்டுப்படைநா- ட்டு நெல்லூரான விக்கிரமசிங்கபுரத்து
[5] திருப்பாற்கடல் சித்திரமெழிவிண்ணகரான பள்ளி- கொண்ட பெருமாளுக்கு அமுதுபடி சாத்துப்படி உள்ளிட்ட நி மந்த-
[6] ங்களுக்கும் திருப்பணிக்கும் உடலாக படைநாட்டுத்- தண்டி. ப்பூறு நாற்பாற்கெல்லைக்கு உட்பட்ட நன்சை- புன்சை நிலம் திருவி-
[7] [டையாட்டம்] லலு-மானியமாக சந்திராதித்தவனா செல்வதாக விட்டென் இயலீவிலக்கினாருண்டாகில் கெங்கை-
[8] [க்கரையில் குர]ாற்பசுக்கொன்றான் பாவத்திலெ|படு வான்.

text.remarks:
Hail! Prosperity! In the Śaka year 1224 Plavanga (Plava ?) corresponding to the 12th year of the reign of the emperor of the three worlds, the glorious Rájagaṇdagópáladéva, on the date corresponding to Monday with the  nakshatra  Róhiñi, the tenth day of the bright half of the month of Makara, I, Madurántukapóttapichóla  alias  Ránganáthan  alias  Rájagaṇdagópáladéva, gave to last as long as the moon and sun to (the god of) Chitraméliviṇṇagar namely Pallikoṇdaperumál at Tiruppáṛkaḍal in Nellúr  alias  Vikramaśingapura (situated) in Padainádu in Chédikulamánikkavaḥanádu (a sub-division) of Jayaṇkoṇdachólamandala, for ceremonies including sacred food, ornaments, daily offerings and temple repairs, free of tax and as exclusive property, the dry and wet lands included within the four boundaries of the village of . . . in Padainádu.
If there is anybody who obstructs this charity, he will incur the sin of killing of a tawny cow on the banks of the Ganges.
doubtless read Plava which is S S. 1224 current. To agree with other inscriptions, however, we ought to have the  expired  Saka year 1224.
text.text_original: [1] ஸ்ஷ் ஸ்ரீ சகரையாண்டு துடாடிசு [பிலவங்க- வகிலசுரி திருவபஙனச்சக்கரவத்திகள் ஸ்ரீ இராசகண்டகொ- பாலதெவற் (க்)கு யாண்டு[2] பன்னிரண்டாவது மகரநாயற்று பூலு-பக்ஷத்து உரு- மியும் திங்கட்சிழமையும் பெற்ற உரொசணிநாள் மதுராந்- தக—[3] ப்பொத்தப்பிச்சொழன் ரெங்கநாதன். ஆன இராசகண்- டகொபாலதெவனென் செயங்கொண்டசொழ-[4] மண்டலத்துச்செதிகுலமாணிக்கவளநாட்டுப்படைநா- ட்டு நெல்லூரான விக்கிரமசிங்கபுரத்து[5] திருப்பாற்கடல் சித்திரமெழிவிண்ணகரான பள்ளி- கொண்ட பெருமாளுக்கு அமுதுபடி சாத்துப்படி உள்ளிட்ட நி மந்த-[6] ங்களுக்கும் திருப்பணிக்கும் உடலாக படைநாட்டுத்- தண்டி. ப்பூறு நாற்பாற்கெல்லைக்கு உட்பட்ட நன்சை- புன்சை நிலம் திருவி-[7] [டையாட்டம்] லலு-மானியமாக சந்திராதித்தவனா செல்வதாக விட்டென் இயலீவிலக்கினாருண்டாகில் கெங்கை-[8] [க்கரையில் குர]ாற்பசுக்கொன்றான் பாவத்திலெ|படு வான்.

cells.object: South wall of Ranganáyakalasvámi temple
cells.remarks: Hail! Prosperity! Under orders verbally received (the following is engraved). In the 31st year of the reign of the emperor of the three worlds who was pleased to take Madurai and the crowned head of the Pándya king, the glorious Kulóttungachóladéva, in the month of Mésha, (the undermentioned) was left (free of tax) by Periyasiddappanáyakka a follower of Madurántakapottapichóla alias Nallasiddharaśa, to the god Chittaraméliviṇnagar alias Pallikonđaperumál at Tirup-párkađal in Nellúr alias Vikramaśingapura (situated) in Pédainádu in Chédikulamánikkavałanádu (a sub division) of Jayañkondachólamandala. He gave with libation of water the village of Viřkádu free of tax to Pallikonđaperumál, the village being included within the four following boundaries viz., on the east the boundary of Kólúr, on the south the boundary of Mérappayúr, on the west the boundary of Yámalúr and on the north the boundary of Kuřattúr, after setting up in (that village) Viřkádu (situated) in the same nádu (Pédainádu) (the image of) Viddharasa-siddharasa. Those who violate this (charity) will incur the sin of those killing a cow on the banks of the Ganges, and the sin of those who kill their parents.
cells.text_original:

[3] [ளி] கொண்டபெருமாளுக்கு மதுராந்தகப்பொத்தப் பிச்சொழநான கல்லவியீரலார் கன்ம்களில் பெரிய சித்தப்ப- நாயக்கன் திருவிடையாட்டமாக விட்ட பரிசாவது [யிக்நா]-
[4] ட்டுவிற்காடு வியீரலா வியீரலா ரையிடுவித்து நிர்வார்- பித்து குடுத் [த] னிதற்கு கிழ்பாற்கெல்லை கொ [ணாரெ] ல்லைக்கு மெற்கும் தென்பாற்கெல்லை மெறப்பயூரெ [ல்லை]க் [கு வட]-
[5] க்கும் மெல்பாற்கெல்லை யாமலூரெல்லைக்கு கிழக்கும் வடபாத கெல்லை குறட்டுரெல்லைக்கு மிக்காற்பாலெல்லைக்குட்ப- ட்ட விற்காடு திருவிடையாட்டமாகப்பள்-ளிகொ [ண்டபெரு- மாளு]-
[6] க்குக்குடுத்தான் இது வில[க்கு] ஹர் கெங்கைக்கரை கு-ராற்பசு கொன்றூர் பாவ[த்]தைப்பவொன் தன்-மாதாபிதாக் களைக்கொன்றூர் பாவத்தெ பொலார்

cells.object: Eastern wall of Rarganáyakula-svámi temple
cells.remarks: Hail! Prosperity! In the 31st year of the reign of the emperor of three worlds, who was pleased to take the glorious Madurai and the crowned head of the Pán-dya, the glorious Kulóttuñgachóladéva, I, Vémayályán the son of Véttandandainambiyándi of the city of Púndamali (situated) in Puliyúrkótta alias Kulóttuñgachólavalanádu, a sub-division of Jayañkondachólamandala, gave to Śrivaráha Emberumáṇ whose image was set up by my father Nambiyándi in the inner sacred enclosure of the temple of Chittiraméliviṇnagar ( alias ) Pallikonđaperumál at Tirupparkađal in Nellúr ( alias ) Vikramaśiñgapuram (situated) in Pédaiuádu in Chédikulamánikkavalanádu, (a sub-division of) this manđala (Jayañkondachólamandala), free of tax, two shares in this Tiruppar-kađal city made up of the shares bought from my father Uṛaṅgávillidásár (otherwise called Nambiyándi) and Mádhavabhatṭaṇ of this city. I, Vémiyályán (the son of) Veṭtandai, gave (these two shares) to last as long as the moon and sun.
cells.text_original:
[1] ஐஹி பூரீ திரிபுவநச்சக்கரலத்திகள் பூரீ மத [ரையும்] பாண்[டிய]ன் முடித்தலையுங்கொ-
[2]ண்டருளின பூரீகுலொத்துங்கசொழதேவர்க்கு யாண்டு நய்க வது ஜயங்கொண்ட-

[4] பூந்தமலி வெட்டந்தைநம்பி[யா]ண்டி மகன் வெமபாழ- வானென் இம்மண்டலத்-

[7] ல் உட்திருச்சுற்றில் [எ]ன்தவப்[ப]நம்பியாண்டி உகந்தருளவித்த சிவராகளம்பெருமானு-
[8] க்கு திருவிடையாட்டமாக இத்திருப்பாற்கடல் அகரத்- து முன்னா[ளி]ல் என்தவப்பன்
[9] உறங்காவில்விதாலர் பாதிகொண்டு விட்ட பாகம் ஒன்றும் இவ்வாண்டுரான இவ்வக-
[10] ரத்து மாதவபட்டன் பாதிகொண்டு விட்ட பாகம் ஒன்- றும் இவ்விரண்டுபாகமு-

text.text_original: [1] ஐஹி பூரீ திரிபுவநச்சக்கரலத்திகள் பூரீ மத [ரையும்] பாண்[டிய]ன் முடித்தலையுங்கொ-[2]ண்டருளின பூரீகுலொத்துங்கசொழதேவர்க்கு யாண்டு நய்க வது ஜயங்கொண்ட-[3] சொ[ழ]மண்டலத்து புவியூர்க்கொட்டமான குலொத்- துங்கசொழவனநாட்டு நகரம்[4] பூந்தமலி வெட்டந்தைநம்பி[யா]ண்டி மகன் வெமபாழ- வானென் இம்மண்டலத்-[5] து செதிகுலமாணிக்கவளநாட்டுப்பெடைநாட்டு நெல் ஆரான விக்கிரமசிங்கபு[ர]-[6] த்து திருப்பாற்கடல் சித்திரமெழிவிண்ணகரான பள்= ளிகொண்டபெருமாள் கொயி-[7] ல் உட்திருச்சுற்றில் [எ]ன்தவப்[ப]நம்பியாண்டி உகந்தருளவித்த சிவராகளம்பெருமானு-[8] க்கு திருவிடையாட்டமாக இத்திருப்பாற்கடல் அகரத்- து முன்னா[ளி]ல் என்தவப்பன்[9] உறங்காவில்விதாலர் பாதிகொண்டு விட்ட பாகம் ஒன்றும் இவ்வாண்டுரான இவ்வக-[10] ரத்து மாதவபட்டன் பாதிகொண்டு விட்ட பாகம் ஒன்- றும் இவ்விரண்டுபாகமு-[11] ம் சந்திராதித்தவரை செல்வதாக கொண்டு விட்டென் வெட்டந்தை வெமயா-[12] ழ்வானென்

cells.object: From shrine of Ranganáyakulasvámi temple
cells.remarks: Hail! Prosperity! In the expired Śaka year 1218 which corresponds with the 6th year of the reign of the emperor of the three worlds, the glorious Vijayagaṇda-gópáladéva, on the date which fell on Wednesday with the Nakshatra Uttiráda and Sankrama, the first day of the bright half of the month of Makara, we, Madurántakapottapichólan alias Ranganáthan alias Rájagaṇdagópáladévau gave for the daily offerings including rice, ornaments, etc., and for sacred building purposes, to the god Chittiraméliviṇṇagar alias Pallikonṇaperumál at Tiruppárkadal in Nellúr alias Vikramasiṇgapura (situated) in Pidainádu in Chédikulamáṇikkavalānádu (a sub-division) of Jayaṇkoṇdachólamandala, with libations of water, free of tax, the dry and wet lands situated within the four boundaries of (the village of) Alangádu in Munṇdainádu. cells.text_original:

In the expired Śaka year 1218 which corresponds with the 6th year of the reign of the emperor of the three worlds, the glorious Vijayagaṇda-gópáladéva, on the date which fell on Wednesday with the Nakshatra Uttiráda and Sankrama, the first day of the bright half of the month of Makara, we, Madurántakapottapichólan  alias  Ranganáthan  alias  Rájagaṇdagópáladévau gave for the daily offerings including rice, ornaments, etc., and for sacred building purposes, to the god Chittiraméliviṇṇagar  alias  Pallikonṇaperumál at Tiruppárkadal in Nellúr  alias  Vikramasiṇgapura (situated) in Pidainádu in Chédikulamáṇikkavalānádu (a sub-division) of Jayaṇkoṇdachólamandala, with libations of water, free of tax, the dry and wet lands situated within the four boundaries of (the village of) Alangádu in Munṇdainádu.

text.text_original: [1]  ல்லி பூரீ சகரையாண்டு து[உா]யெ-செல்லாநின்றதிரிபுவனச்சக்கரவத்திகள் பூரீவிை[சயகண்டகொ]பால.-[2]  தெவற்கு யாண்டு சுவது மகரநாயற்று எடுலுப்பக்ஷத்து வருகமையும் புதன்கிழமையு[ம்] பெற்ற[3]  உத்திராடமும் சங்கிரமுமான நாள் ஜயங்கொண்ட-சொழமண்டலத்துச்செதிகுலமாணிக்க-[4]  வளநாட்டுப்பிடைநாட்டு நெல்லூரான ஷ்[க் *]கு[ர *] மசிங்கபுரத்துத்திருப்பாற்கடர்சித்திரமெழிவிண்ண-[5]  கரான பள்ளிகொண்டபெருமாளுக்கு அமுதுபடி சாத்துப்படி உள்ளிட்ட நித்தநிமந்தங்களுக்கும் திருப்பணிக்கும்[6]  உடலாக மதுராந்தகபொத்த[ப்பி]சொழன் பூரீரங்கநாதரான இராஜ[கண்] டகொபா[ல]தெவன் முண்டைநாட்டு அலங்காடு[7]  நாற்பாற்கெல்லைக்கு உட்பட்ட நன்[சை]புன்[சை]யும் உள்ளடங்கலுந் திருவிடையாட்டமரக[ச்ச]ந்திராதித்தவரை-செல்ல உதக-[8]  எடுலுப்மாக குடுத்தேரம் இலிடிம்[வி]லக்கினார் கங்கைக்கரையிற்குராற்பசு[க்ெ]கான்றான் பாவத்திலே படக்கடவன்

cells.object: From shrine of Ranganáyakulasvámi temple
cells.remarks: Hail! Prosperity! In the Śaka year 1237 expired which corresponds to the 25th year of the reign of the emperor of the three worlds, the glorious Rájagaṇdagópáladéva on the date which corresponded to Wednesday with the nakshatra Punarpúṣa, the tenth day of the bright half of the month of Mina , Madurántakapottapichóla alias . . . . Rájagaṇdagópáladévan . . . . gave . . . . for the sacred lamp and ghee to the god at Chitramélivinnagar, Pallikondaperumál at Nellúr alias Vikramaśingapuram (situated) in Pidainádu in Chédikulamáṇikkavalaṇádu (a. sub-division) of Jayankondachólamaṇdala. [Imprecatory lines.]
cells.text_original:
[1] லுவி பூசகரையாண்டு துடா[ஈ]யிள செல்லா[ஈ]ின்ற [திரிபுவனச்ச]க்கரவுத்கிகள் பூசிராஜகண்டகொபா . . . .
[2] யாண்டு உய்ருவது மினநாயற்று வட்டுலுப்பக்ஷத்து [தெசமியும் புதந்]கிழமையும் பெற்ற புணர்பூசத்திந . . . .
[3] கொண்டசொழமண்டலத்துச்செதிகுலமாணிக்க[வள-நாட்டு]ப்பிடைநாட்டு நெல்லூ[ரான] . . . .
[4] கபுரத்துத்திருப்பாற்கடற் சித்திரமெழி[விண்ணக]ரா-ன பள்ளிகொண் . . . .
[5] திருவிளக்குக்கும் நெய்பமுதுக்கும் உட[லா]க மது[ராந்த]கப்டு[பா]த்தப்பிச்சொழன் பூசி . . . .
[6] இராஜகண்டகொபாலதெவன் நிலனமவ . . . .
னவிடோம் இது விலகினார்
cells.notes: NOTE.—The regnal year was first read as 25th but on check  in suu  as 15th. A further reference to the estampage confirms the reading 25th. The Śaka year too is doubtful and we may read either 1227 and 15th or 1237 and 25th. The Śaka year was first read as current but on check as expired.

cells.object: From shrine of Irukalamma temple
cells.remarks: Hail ! On Monday the 15th of the dark fortnight of Bhádrapada of the year Ánanda corresponding to the Srí Śaka year 1239, while Sríman Mahámandalésvara Kákatiya Pratáparudradéva Mahárájulu was ruling the earth in pleasant communication (with his feudatories), Nágayánulóka Bóyuđu and Brammana Bóyuđu, the sons of Hari Déva, the servant of Nágaṇagaṇa, caused to be constructed behind . . . Srí Ranganátha for the merit of the agent and viceroy of that Pratáparudradéva Mahárajalu, (namely) Srí Muppađi Náyani Gáru and of Pedda Rudra Dévani Gáru for the prosperity of the kingdom, for the falling of rain thrice a month at Nellúr and for the increase of wealth. . . Pina Bóyunđu and Siddaya Bóyuđu . . . Irukalá Paramésvari in Nellúr . . . . we have granted. He who does harm to this charity will incur the sin of killing a tawny cow on the Ganges and the Bhágírathi. This charity should last as long as the sun and moon exist. Thus have we granted. . . . . May it cause great prosperity.
cells.text_original:
1. స్వస్తి శ్రీ శకవర్షంబు ంతిక అగునేంటి ఆనంద సం వత్సర భాద్రవద శుద్ధ ంగ సో॥ శ్రీ మన్వహా మండ లేశ్వర కాకతియ్య వ్రతావ రుద్రదేవ షహారాజిలు సుఖసంకతావి
2. నోదంబునం బ్రిధివీరాజ్యము జేయచుండంగాను ఆ వ్రతా వ రుద్రదేవ మహారాజిల
వారి కౌగ్యకత భారత భారత భారత భారత భారత భారత భారత భారత భారత భారత భారత భారత భారత భారత భారత భారత
3. బ్రిద్ధిగాను నెల్లూరి భూమికి నెలమూండువవుములు కు వు ధనకనక సమృద్ధిగానుంను నాగణ గణభృత్యుండు హరిదేవని కొడుక్షు నాగయానులోకబోయుం డూసు బ్రంపునబోయుండూసు శ్రీ రంగనాధుండుని వెనుక
4. (గట్టించిరి) పినబోయండూసు సిద్ధయబోయుడూసు . . . యుబోయుండూసు . . . . రహరహభ . . . లూసు .
క . . తం ఇ . . . . నెల్లూరిలోంన ఇరుకలా వరమే శ్వరికి నెలమి ఆఱుస . . . డ జఱు పముగాను చెనదా
5. . . ను . . . నెలమండడకులక . . . లమేర . . . డి నడవు వాండు ఇ కాంవును . . . .
6. రి కిస్తిమి ఇ ధరమ్మమునకు నెవ్వండు విఫలము తలంచి నాను భాగీరధి గంగకఱుత కి పిలలేను వధి
7. ఇంచినదోషం వారు ఇదరమ్మును చంద్రసూయ్యులు క లంత కాలము నుండునఱుల ఇచ్చినవారు . . . .
8. శ్రీ-య్యకుల . . . . మంగళమహా శ్రీశ్రీశ్రీం జేయును
cells.notes: NOTE.—Ananda is S.S. 1237 current but perhaps we should read Anala (A.D. 1316-17).

text.object: Over shrine of temple
text.remarks:
Hail! Prosperity! In the 31st year of the reign of the emperor of the three worlds, the glorious Kulóttuṅgachólādéva who was pleased to take Madura and the crowned head of the Pánḍya (king), Madurántakapottapichólā  alias  Tirukkálattidéva gave to Manumákéśava Perumál of Manumakéśavapura (a suburb) of Nellúr  alias  Vikramasingapura (situated) in Pérúrnádu in Chédikulamáṇikkavalānádu (a sub-division) of Jayaṅgoṇdachólāmaṇdala, free of tax, the village of Iđappúr situated in Maṇdainádu (a sub-division) of this nádu (Chédikulamáṇikkavalānádu).
The boundaries of this village are: on the west the boundary of  Sáṇi ; on the south the boundary of  Vāvikai ; (To face page 864.)
NELLORE NO. 101.
NELLORE DISTRICT..
on the west the boundary of  Tirukkānjéru ; and on the north the boundary of  Purundil .

cells.object: On the western wall of the temple
cells.remarks: Hail! On Sunday the 7th of Chaitra of the year Viródhikrīt, corresponding to 1473 of the illustrious, victorious and prosperous Śáliváhana Śaka era, while Śrīmad Rájádhirája Rájaparamésvara Víra Prátápa Śrí Sadáśivadéva Maháráya, seated on the diamond throne at Vijayanagar, was ruling the earth, Rámi Reddi, son of Duvvúri Kondávara Nandi Reddi, granted a charitable edict as follows after making obeisance to Sangamésvaradéva, for the religious merit of Chivvakalúri Bayacha Rájayya, who is the governor (ádhipati) of Udayagiri rájya which belongs to the chiefdom of Śrīman Manđalésvara Rámarájayya Śrí Tirumalayya déva Mahárájulayya. We have presented with libation of water the proceeds realized from the sale of the produce of the tope planted by us in the sthala of Sangam in Udayagiri rájyam for providing worship with light to Sangamésvara. We have done this under the orders of Śrí Mahá Manđalésvara apratihata (invincible) Paricheja Mummayadéva Chóda Mahárája. Duvvúri Rámi Reddi.

cells.object: From stone in front of temple. Translation conjectural in parts
cells.remarks: Hail! On Monday the 7th of the dark fortnight of Chaitra of the year Pramódúta corresponding to the victorious and prosperous Śáliváhana Śaka year 1492 when Śrímád Rájádhi Rája, Rája Paraméśvara, Śrí Víra Pratápa Sadáśiva Maháráya, seated on the diamond throne was ruling the earth, we Veligoti Timmappa Náyanimgáru, the agent (káryakarta) of Śríman Mahá Mandaléśvara Rámarája Śrí Ranga Rájayyadéva Mahárájulayya, after making obeisance to Sangaméśvaradéva, have given this charitable edict. On the holy occasion of Mésha-Sankránti, with a libation of water, for providing all enjoyments and worship to Sangaméśvara, we have remitted the taxes on cattle and sundry articles of merchandise and the service for the river channel and the vetṭi fees for the religious merit of Rangarájayya. Therefore, if any person obstructs this charity, he will incur the sin of killing his parents at Kási. This charitable deed has been granted in perpetuity to last as long as the sun and the moon exist. Śrí! Śrí!

text.object: From stone in front of temple. Translation conjectural in parts
text.remarks: Hail! On Monday the 7th of the dark fortnight of Chaitra of the year Pramódúta corresponding to the victorious and prosperous Śáliváhana Śaka year 1492 when Śrímád Rájádhi Rája, Rája Paraméśvara, Śrí Víra Pratápa Sadáśiva Maháráya, seated on the diamond throne was ruling the earth, we Veligoti Timmappa Náyanimgáru, the agent (káryakarta) of Śríman Mahá Mandaléśvara Rámarája Śrí Ranga Rájayyadéva Mahárájulayya, after making obeisance to Sangaméśvaradéva, have given this charitable edict. On the holy occasion of Mésha-Sankránti, with a libation of water, for providing all enjoyments and worship to Sangaméśvara, we have remitted the taxes on cattle and sundry articles of merchandise and the service for the river channel and the  vetṭi  fees for the religious merit of Rangarájayya. Therefore, if any person obstructs this charity, he will incur the sin of killing his parents at Kási. This charitable deed has been granted in perpetuity to last as long as the sun and the moon exist. Śrí! Śrí!

cells.remarks: On the 8th day of the bright fortnight of Bhádrapada of the year Yuva, under the orders of Ákula Ranganáthayya the agent of Śrímat Velugóti Venkaṭapatináyaniváru, Bóyanapalli Bápanayagáru issued charitable edict for the kuncha grain of the tank. text.remarks: On the 8th day of the bright fortnight of Bhádrapada of the year Yuva, under the orders of Ákula Ranganáthayya the agent of Śrímat Velugóti Venkaṭapatináyaniváru, Bóyanapalli Bápanayagáru issued charitable edict for the  kuncha  grain of the tank. cells.object: From rock on Póléramma-mitta
cells.remarks: Hail! On the 5th of the bright half of Chaitra of the year Chitrablánu, corresponding to the year 1504 of the illustrious, victorious and prosperous Šáliváhana Šaka era, while Šrímad Rájádhirája, Rája Paramésvara Šrí Víra Pratápa Šrí Víra Rangaráyadéva Mahárájulugáru, seated on the diamond throne at the city of Penugonda, was ruling the earth, Kónéti China Timma Náyanimgáru of the Vellatla gótra , grandson of Rávéla Karti Náyanimgáru, and son of Tirumalayyagáru, issued a charitable edict for the tank. The old grant of méras at 1 kuncha per putti for the tank at the village, of Viđavalúru, situated in Udayagiri śima , which was granted for our chiefdom by the king has been discontinued. Therefore we have again granted méras at 1 kuncha per putti on all kinds of grain raised in the village, including fields leased by the estate, garden lands, and bhata vritti mányams (personal inams), for the religious merit of the above said China Kónéti Timmanáyanímgáru and to last as long as the sun and moon exist. We have also given 100 kuntas under the tank to the south of the báđava (marshy land) as a mányam . This is the charitable edict issued for doing work to the tank every year, with the yearly income derived from the mányam and the méras at 1 kuncha per putti . Those who fail in this will incur the sin of killing cows and Brahmans on the banks of the Ganges, and will incur the sin of killing their parents at Benares. If any one speaks ill of this, the Upparas will ravish his wife; also Angírula Súrađu will ravish his wife. Srí! Srí! Srí! [One imprecatory verse.]
cells.text_original:
1. స్వస్తిశ్రీ జయాభ్యుదయ శాలివా
2. వాన శకవర్షంబులు ంచింద అగునేటి చిత్రభా
3. ను సంవత్సర వైత్ర శు ౭ లు శ్రీమద్రాజాధిరాజ రా
4. జ పరమేశ్వర శ్రీ వీరవ్రతాప శ్రీ వీర రంగరాయ దే
5. వ మహారాయలుంగారు పెనుగొండనగరమందు వజ్ర శిరి
6. హ్వస నారూఠుడై పృథివ్వ సామ్రాజ్యము చేయుచును
7. వెల్లట్ల గోతృలైన రావేల (కం) టి నాయిణింగారి పౌతృ లైన తి
8. రుచులయ్యంగారి పుతృలైన కోనేటి చిన తింమానాయనిం
9. గారు ఇబ్బిన చెరువు ధర్మశాసనం రాయులవారు మా నాయం
10. కరానకు పాలించిఇచ్చిన పుడయగిరిశీమలాని విడవలూ రి గ్రా
11. మానను చెరు, పు పుట్టికుంచాలు పూవాన సాగింది ఖిలపడి పుండు
12. గనక ఆచినకోనేటి తిమ్మనంగారికి పుణ్యంగాను ఆచంద్రా కళంగా
13. ను గ్రామాననుపండిన నానాధాన్యానకు నగరి కమతా లనుములు
14. పులను భటబ్రిహీమాన్యాలును సహ వి త్తినపుటికల పుట్టికి కుం
15. చడు మేరసాగింస్తిమి మాన్యం చెరువుకిందను బాడవ లాన
16. దక్షణం నూరుకుంటలు ఇస్తిమి మాన్యంవల్లను పుట్టికుంచా
17. లవలను యాటవచ్చినవి యాంట చెరువుమీంద పనిశేయుటకు
18. ఇట్టని ఇచ్చిన ధమ్‌శౌసానం ఇందుకుతప్పినవాండుగంగ కత్త్‌
19. గోవు బ్రాంహని చంపిన పాపానపోదురు వారణాసిలోను తమ
20. తక్లితండ్రుల వధించిన పాపానపోదురు ఇందుకు యవ్వ
21. ండు కీడాడిన వానిఆలిని పడందిసియ యెటి వువరవారు
22. దెంగుదురు మరిని వానిఆలిని ఆంగీరుల సూరడు
23. దెంగును శ్రీ శ్రీ శ్రీ స్వదత్తా ద్విగుణంపుణ్యం పర
24. దత్తానుపాలనం పరదత్తాపహారేణ స్వదత్తం నిష్పలం
25. భవేత్ ॥

On Wednesday, the 10th of the bright fortnight of Chaitra of the year Ánanda, corresponding to 1236 of the illustrious and prosperous Śaka era, on the day of Vishvu Sankránti, Rudranáyakulu made a charitable gift to Ishta Káméśvaramahádévara of Aralúru, consisting of kóru land wherein '15 marttu can be sown, to last as long as the sun and moon exist. This vritti is given as a sarvamánya . Whatever ryots cultivate these fields they will not have to pay tax. This is given for the religious merit of Pratáparudra Mahárája. Those who protect this (charity) will get religious merit. On the contrary, any one who thinks of injuring it, will be considered to have committed incest with his sister and to have allowed his wife to be covered by a donkey.
cells.text_original:
స్వదస్త్రం | వరదత్తంవా | యోహారేతి | వమంధరా
షష్టివరుణ సహస్ర్రాణి విష్ట్రాయా జాయతే క్రిమిః
స్వవ్వీత్రి శుభ శకవరుణంబులు ౧౨౩౬ ఆగునేంటి ఆనం
దస్త్రంవత్సర చైత్రశుద్ధ ౧౦ బుధవారమునాండు
విఘల్ సంక్రాంతి దినమునవ్యుడు అజలూరి
శ్రీ ఇష్టకామేశ్వర శ్రీ మహదేవరకు రుద్ర
నాయనింగారు చేసిన దమ్ముదానం కొరునేలపెట్టిన మ
త్తుణలువేసి ౧౫ ఆవంద్రతారాక్షము ఈ బ్రిత్తి సవణ
మాన్యము ఈచేలు ఏకాంపులు దున్నా
ను వంగ్గములేదు ఈ దముణవు వ్రతావ
రుద్రదేవ మహారాజాకుం బుణ్యము
గానిచ్చినది వ్రతిపాలించినవారికిం బుణ్య
ము ఆస్సుగాక చెఱ్చందలంచినవాడు దమ
చెలియలిం తాంబోయిన వాండు దన
ఆడిది గాడిదలం దెంగ్గించినవాండు
cells.notes: NOTE—See also O. 99.

text.object: On a big stone in the temple of Ishta Káméśvara
text.remarks:
[One imprecatory verse.]
Hail! On Wednesday, the 10th of the bright fortnight of Chaitra of the year Ánanda, corresponding to 1236 of the illustrious and prosperous Śaka era, on the day of Vishvu Sankránti, Rudranáyakulu made a charitable gift to Ishta Káméśvaramahádévara of Aralúru, consisting of kóru land wherein '15  marttu  can be sown, to last as long as the sun and moon exist. This  vritti  is given as a  sarvamánya . Whatever ryots cultivate these fields they will not have to pay tax. This is given for the religious merit of Pratáparudra Mahárája. Those who protect this (charity) will get religious merit. On the contrary, any one who thinks of injuring it, will be considered to have committed incest with his sister and to have allowed his wife to be covered by a donkey.
text.text_original: స్వదస్త్రం | వరదత్తంవా | యోహారేతి | వమంధరాషష్టివరుణ సహస్ర్రాణి విష్ట్రాయా జాయతే క్రిమిఃస్వవ్వీత్రి శుభ శకవరుణంబులు ౧౨౩౬ ఆగునేంటి ఆనందస్త్రంవత్సర చైత్రశుద్ధ ౧౦ బుధవారమునాండువిఘల్ సంక్రాంతి దినమునవ్యుడు అజలూరిశ్రీ ఇష్టకామేశ్వర శ్రీ మహదేవరకు రుద్రనాయనింగారు చేసిన దమ్ముదానం కొరునేలపెట్టిన మత్తుణలువేసి ౧౫ ఆవంద్రతారాక్షము ఈ బ్రిత్తి సవణమాన్యము ఈచేలు ఏకాంపులు దున్నాను వంగ్గములేదు ఈ దముణవు వ్రతావరుద్రదేవ మహారాజాకుం బుణ్యముగానిచ్చినది వ్రతిపాలించినవారికిం బుణ్యము ఆస్సుగాక చెఱ్చందలంచినవాడు దమచెలియలిం తాంబోయిన వాండు దనఆడిది గాడిదలం దెంగ్గించినవాండు
text.notes: NOTE—See also O. 99.

cells.object: Inside the Ishta Káméşvara temple
cells.remarks: Hail ! On Wednesday, the 10th of the dark fortnight of Srávaṇa of the year Pingala, corresponding to 1:239 of the illustrious and prosperous Śaka era. Gála Muddana Bóyundu and Dana Mádhava, in the presence of Pinnaya Venkangáru, the Reddis of Aralúr, the karnams and all people, gave as charity 50 kuntas and 1 kunchađu of ghee per month for lighting the lamp to Ishta Káméşvara of Aralúru, for the religious merit of Sríman Mahámandaléşvara Pratápa Rudradéva Mahárájuluváru and will acquire merit. Those who protect this charity will acquire religious merit.
cells.text_original:
స్వ ప్రీ శుభ
శకవషణంబులు
౧౨౩౯ అగునేం
టి పింగళ సంవత్సర
శ్రావణ ఐహళ ౧౦
బు స్వ ప్లిత్రీ మన్నహా మ
ండలేశ్వర ప్రతావరుద్ర
దేవమహారాజాలకు
ంబుణ్యమ్ము గాను పిన్న
య వెంకంగారును ఆఱ
లూరి రెడ్లున్ను కరణాలున్న
సమ న్త ప్రజానె ఱంగ్గను గా
లముద్దన బోయుండు దన
మాదవ్రలు ఏంబదికు
౫౦ కల్నును అఱలూరి ఇ
ప్ర కామేశ్వర దేవర
రికిని అఖండ్డ దీవమున
కు నెలకుం గుంచండు నె ఇ
వోసి ప్రణ్యము ఆనుభ
వించువాండు ఈ ధమ్
పు స్రతిపాలించ్చి ప్రణ్య
మునం బొంద్దువారు
ఏలికలు—
cells.notes: NOTE.—The modern village of Allúr according to this inscription was formerly called Aralúr.

text.object: Inside the Ishta Káméşvara temple
text.remarks: Hail ! On Wednesday, the 10th of the dark fortnight of Srávaṇa of the year Pingala, corresponding to 1:239 of the illustrious and prosperous Śaka era. Gála Muddana Bóyundu and Dana Mádhava, in the presence of Pinnaya Venkangáru, the Reddis of Aralúr, the karnams and all people, gave as charity 50  kuntas  and 1  kunchađu  of ghee per month for lighting the lamp to Ishta Káméşvara of Aralúru, for the religious merit of Sríman Mahámandaléşvara Pratápa Rudradéva Mahárájuluváru and will acquire merit. Those who protect this charity will acquire religious merit.
text.text_original: స్వ ప్రీ శుభశకవషణంబులు౧౨౩౯ అగునేంటి పింగళ సంవత్సరశ్రావణ ఐహళ ౧౦బు స్వ ప్లిత్రీ మన్నహా మండలేశ్వర ప్రతావరుద్రదేవమహారాజాలకుంబుణ్యమ్ము గాను పిన్నయ వెంకంగారును ఆఱలూరి రెడ్లున్ను కరణాలున్నసమ న్త ప్రజానె ఱంగ్గను గాలముద్దన బోయుండు దనమాదవ్రలు ఏంబదికు౫౦ కల్నును అఱలూరి ఇప్ర కామేశ్వర దేవరరికిని అఖండ్డ దీవమునకు నెలకుం గుంచండు నె ఇవోసి ప్రణ్యము ఆనుభవించువాండు ఈ ధమ్పు స్రతిపాలించ్చి ప్రణ్యమునం బొంద్దువారుఏలికలు—
text.notes: NOTE.—The modern village of Allúr according to this inscription was formerly called Aralúr.

cells.object: On stone by the Ishta Kámésvara temple
cells.remarks: Hail ! In the month of Áshádha of the year Rávudri corresponding to 1242 of the illustrious and prosperous Śálivahana Śaka era, Śríman Bamma Náyaningáru gave as vritti 400 kuntas of dry land to the deity Śrí Ishta Kámésvara Mahádéva of Aralúr, and 100 kuntas for worshipping, to last as long as the sun and moon exist to secure religious merit for (Hail !) Sríman Mahámanda-lésvara Pratápa Rudra Déva Mahárájulu. Let these two charities be maintained (?). We have given 100 kuntas of dry land as a sarvamánya .
cells.text_original:
స్వస్తి శ్రీ
శుభశాలివాహన
శకవషంబు
ల ౧౨౪ ౨ ఆస
నెంటి రౌద్రి సంవ
త్పర ఆషాఢన
స్వస్తి శ్రీ మన్మహ
మండలేశ్వర వ్రతా
ప రుద్రదేవ మహా
రాజులకుం బుణ్యం
బుగాను శ్రీమత్
బమ్మయినాయ్యంగారు
ఆఱలూరి శ్రీ ఇష్ట శా
మేశ్వర మహా దేవరకు
బ్రి శ్రీ ౪౦౦ సంట
లు వెలి నెను అర్పన బ్రి శ్రీ
౧౦౦ సంటలు ఆ చంద్రా
ర్కముగా నిచ్చిరి దమ్ము
వుంజంట . సెనెడివారు
రివలి నెను ౧౦౦ సంటలు
. . . సవకమా
స్యములుంగ మాస్యము
ఇస్తిమి
cells.notes: NOTE.— The donor re-appears in the following inscription.

text.object: On stone by the Ishta Kámésvara temple
text.remarks: Hail ! In the month of Áshádha of the year Rávudri corresponding to 1242 of the illustrious and prosperous Śálivahana Śaka era, Śríman Bamma Náyaningáru gave as  vritti  400  kuntas  of dry land to the deity Śrí Ishta Kámésvara Mahádéva of Aralúr, and 100  kuntas  for worshipping, to last as long as the sun and moon exist to secure religious merit for (Hail !) Sríman Mahámanda-lésvara Pratápa Rudra Déva Mahárájulu. Let these two charities be maintained (?). We have given 100  kuntas  of dry land as a  sarvamánya .
text.text_original: స్వస్తి శ్రీశుభశాలివాహనశకవషంబుల ౧౨౪ ౨ ఆసనెంటి రౌద్రి సంవత్పర ఆషాఢనస్వస్తి శ్రీ మన్మహమండలేశ్వర వ్రతాప రుద్రదేవ మహారాజులకుం బుణ్యంబుగాను శ్రీమత్బమ్మయినాయ్యంగారుఆఱలూరి శ్రీ ఇష్ట శామేశ్వర మహా దేవరకుబ్రి శ్రీ ౪౦౦ సంటలు వెలి నెను అర్పన బ్రి శ్రీ౧౦౦ సంటలు ఆ చంద్రార్కముగా నిచ్చిరి దమ్మువుంజంట . సెనెడివారురివలి నెను ౧౦౦ సంటలు. . . సవకమాస్యములుంగ మాస్యముఇస్తిమి
text.notes: NOTE.— The donor re-appears in the following inscription.

cells.object: On the same stone by the temple of Ishta Káméśvaradéva
cells.remarks: Hail! On the 11th of the bright fortnight of Ashádha of the year Ravudri, corresponding to the year 1242 of the illustrious and prosperous Śáliváhana Śaka era, Śrímat Bamaya Naiđu Gáru gave to Ishta Káméśvaradéva of Aralúru 400 kuntas as vritti and 100 kuntas of dry land as archana vritti 1 for the religious merit of (Hail!) Śríman Mahámanđaléśvara Pratápa Rudradéva Mahárájulu to last as long as the sun and moon exist. He has given for (lighting) a lamp to the deity 50 kuntas of dry land at Nannalapádu as a sarvamánya free from tax. To those who make this great gift will accrue the merit of performing many gifts, and the gift of cows; to those who injure (the charity) there will be hell and all kinds of misery. [One imprecatory verse.]
cells.text_original:
First side.
న్వస్తిత్రే
శుభ శాలివహంన
శెకవకంబు
బ ౧౯౮౨ అను
నెటి రౌద్రి సెంకం
త్సర ఆషాఢ శు.
ద్వ ౧౧
న్వస్తిత్రే మన్మహ
మండలేశ్వర వ్రతా
ప రుద్రదేవ మహా
రాజిలకుం బుణ్య
ముగాను శ్రీమతు
బిమయ నాయ్నింగారు
అఱలూరి శ్రీ ఇష్టతా
మేశ్వర దేవరకు
. . . బ్రిత్తి రంం గుంట
లు వెలిసెను అర్చనబ్రిత్తి
౧౦౦ గుంటలు ఆ చంద్రా
కణముగా నిచ్చిరి దేవరకు
వుం డెంటి సేసి దిపానకు
కి వెలిసెను ౫౦ గుంటలు
నన్నలపాటందు సెవణమా
న్యము వంగమాన్యము
Second side.
ను నిచ్చిరి
ఈ మహాదానం
చెల్లించ్చిన దానా
లనేకం ఇట్ల గోవు
ల దానమును సేసిన
ఫలమును పొ
ందువారు ఉప
ద్రము సేసినవారి
కి నరకము సెకలా
దిగ ద్రోహాలు
స్వదత్తం పరదత్తం
వా యోహారేతి
వసుంధరా ష
ప్రి వరుష సెహ
స్రాణి కిష్టాయా
ం జాయతేక్రిమి
cells.notes: 1  Land granted for the purpose of conducting worship.

text.object: On the same stone by the temple of Ishta Káméśvaradéva
text.remarks:
Hail! On the 11th of the bright fortnight of Ashádha of the year Ravudri, corresponding to the year 1242 of the illustrious and prosperous Śáliváhana Śaka era, Śrímat Bamaya Naiđu Gáru gave to Ishta Káméśvaradéva of Aralúru 400  kuntas  as  vritti  and 100  kuntas  of dry land as  archana vritti  1  for the religious merit of (Hail!) Śríman Mahámanđaléśvara Pratápa Rudradéva Mahárájulu to last as long as the sun and moon exist. He has given for (lighting) a lamp to the deity 50  kuntas  of dry land at Nannalapádu as a  sarvamánya  free from tax. To those who make this great gift will accrue the merit of performing many gifts, and the gift of cows; to those who injure (the charity) there will be hell and all kinds of misery.
[One imprecatory verse.]
text.text_original: First side.న్వస్తిత్రేశుభ శాలివహంనశెకవకంబుబ ౧౯౮౨ అనునెటి రౌద్రి సెంకంత్సర ఆషాఢ శు.ద్వ ౧౧న్వస్తిత్రే మన్మహమండలేశ్వర వ్రతాప రుద్రదేవ మహారాజిలకుం బుణ్యముగాను శ్రీమతుబిమయ నాయ్నింగారుఅఱలూరి శ్రీ ఇష్టతామేశ్వర దేవరకు. . . బ్రిత్తి రంం గుంటలు వెలిసెను అర్చనబ్రిత్తి౧౦౦ గుంటలు ఆ చంద్రాకణముగా నిచ్చిరి దేవరకువుం డెంటి సేసి దిపానకుకి వెలిసెను ౫౦ గుంటలునన్నలపాటందు సెవణమాన్యము వంగమాన్యముSecond side.ను నిచ్చిరిఈ మహాదానంచెల్లించ్చిన దానాలనేకం ఇట్ల గోవుల దానమును సేసినఫలమును పొందువారు ఉపద్రము సేసినవారికి నరకము సెకలాదిగ ద్రోహాలుస్వదత్తం పరదత్తంవా యోహారేతివసుంధరా షప్రి వరుష సెహస్రాణి కిష్టాయాం జాయతేక్రిమి

cells.object: From eastern pillar of mandapam of Chenna Kéšava temple. Not quite clear in parts
cells.remarks: On the 10th of the dark fortnight of Jyéshtha of the year Yuva, Tiruvírunendu, Gudhani Nírigáru, and the Kápus of Ammanabrólu, Yádattidiráya, Dammála Pápandu, Yaranalúri Mallayya, Nallapáti Póllayya, the motarfa 1 Kápus , the karnams, the sthalakarnams , and Mélúri Anantayya, after making obeisance, issued this charitable edict to the deities and barbers of Ammanabrólu. Formerly méras used to be in the possession of Kéšavadéva in Ammanabrólu. In addition to the following items granted by us the Kápus , namely, 10 putītis of sáluva (?), 4 túms of dry, 4 (?) of land under the tank, the Panta Reddis , 2 karnams and cultivators should give ( méras ) at 3 túms on every putīi of produce, and 3 putītis . . . . (?) The ten putītis of land that have been given should not be taxed. [What follows is not clear; the general meaning is that, if objections are taken to the grant, Náráya Kondóji is to see that it is carried out. The inscription ends with certain signatures.]

cells.object: Opposite Śiva temple
cells.remarks: Salutation be to the glorious Raghunáyaka (Ráma) ! V. 1. Salutation be to Śambhu (Śiva) who is charming, as with a chámara , with the moon which kisses his lofty head, and who is the main pillar of the creation of the city of the three worlds. V. 2. May the staff-like tusk of Hari, who assumed in sport the form of a Boar—resting on which the earth with Mount Méru as its apex resembled an umbrella—protect you. Vs. 3 and 4. May that descendant of Yadu, who though without support is of immense size,—in regard to whom the moon is the growing nail, the celestial tree is the line of the fingers of the hand, the cow of plenty is this nectar-like speech, the desire-fulfilling stone is the eye, the line of clouds is the incomparable hue of the body, and the ocean of nectar is the mercy—protect you always. V. 4. Náráyana, in a palace of gems, resembling the Śvétadvípa where celestial trees abode, in the milk ocean, is adored by Sanaka and other sages, Garuda and the lord of serpents. His glory is eternal bliss and knowledge and is supreme (without a second). Being the soul of all, and the origin of truth, he is eternally resplendent; and his form is characterized by the lotus which is the face of Ráma. V. 5. From his navel-lotus was formerly born the creator (Brahma) from whom the world was created. His mind-born son was Vasishtha, the best of sages His son was Śakti, the store-house of good precepts, the ocean of compassion. His son was the sage Paráśara of pure intellect, devotee of Vishnu, thereby excelling all. In his exalted gótra were born Vyása, the gem of preceptors, the Brahmans, Śuka and others, granters of the merit of the scriptures which deserve to be praised. V. 6. . . . Then shines king Singa who was like a lion . . . to the elephants . . ., who was possessed of might resembling that of . . . [V. 7. The verse as it stands makes no sense. Its purport seems to be that Singárya was esteemed by the Carnatic kings.] V. 8. text.remarks:
Salutation be to the glorious Raghunáyaka (Ráma) !
V. 1. Salutation be to Śambhu (Śiva) who is charming, as with a  chámara , with the moon which kisses his lofty head, and who is the main pillar of the creation of the city of the three worlds.
V. 2. May the staff-like tusk of Hari, who assumed in sport the form of a Boar—resting on which the earth with Mount Méru as its apex resembled an umbrella—protect you.
Vs. 3 and 4. May that descendant of Yadu, who though without support is of immense size,—in regard to whom the moon is the growing nail, the celestial tree is the line of the fingers of the hand, the cow of plenty is this nectar-like speech, the desire-fulfilling stone is the eye, the line of clouds is the incomparable hue of the body, and the ocean of nectar is the mercy—protect you always.
V. 4. Náráyana, in a palace of gems, resembling the Śvétadvípa where celestial trees abode, in the milk ocean, is adored by Sanaka and other sages, Garuda and the lord of serpents. His glory is eternal bliss and knowledge and is supreme (without a second). Being the soul of all, and the origin of truth, he is eternally resplendent; and his form is characterized by the lotus which is the face of Ráma.
V. 5. From his navel-lotus was formerly born the creator (Brahma) from whom the world was created. His mind-born son was Vasishtha, the best of sages His son was Śakti, the store-house of good precepts, the ocean of compassion. His son was the sage Paráśara of pure intellect, devotee of Vishnu, thereby excelling all.
In his exalted  gótra  were born Vyása, the gem of preceptors, the Brahmans, Śuka and others, granters of the merit of the scriptures which deserve to be praised.
V. 6. . . . Then shines king Singa who was like a lion . . . to the elephants . . ., who was possessed of might resembling that of . . .
[V. 7. The verse as it stands makes no sense. Its purport seems to be that Singárya was esteemed by the Carnatic kings.]
V. 8. His son was Bhava, the prince of ministers, who acquired victory by polity; who made king Apa a dependant on his feet by means of the profusion of the splendour of his fame which shines like the milk ocean and the autumnal cloud, who made all the elephants of the cardinal points shine like Indra's elephant, able to read the thoughts of others, of illuminating speech. His son was the glorious king Rámachandra, who was as handsome as Indra's son (Jayanta), who by the fierce sword resembling Ráhu destroyed the moon and the sun of the fame and valour respectively of his enemies, who was eminent in might, who in valour resembled lighted fire, who in great fortitude resembled the mountain of gems (Méru), who was always a  Kámadhénu  (cow of plenty) to his relations.
Srí Ráma—
Devoted to Dharma, who had destroyed the heap of his enemies' arrows . . ... army, whose . . .
was possessed of Ganesa's strength, who resembled the son of the daughter of ocean (Káma) devotee of Rághava —Mádhava.
He, king Ráma, married a wife named Telingama who resembled Anasúyá in virtue, of radiant speech, the earth (abode) of fame, sprung from the Lohita race, of great splendour, daughter of the Gangárya race, famed in the three worlds for chastity.
The ocean which was Ráma bore on the Ganges which was Talingama five sons who resembled the celestial trees (5), liberal to the gods (scholars).
Timma Malla Suréndra Bháskara Chamúpati . . . .
Bha . . nárya The worshipper of the feet of Śrí Raghuráma, the benefactor of intelligent men, serene, whose speech resembled nectar towards sages, calm.
Śrí Timma . . famed as Kártavírya.
Śrí China Timma Mantritilaka was peerless.
The brothers China Timma and Bháskara Chamúnátha possessing the splendour of Ráma and Lakshmana, praiseworthy like Ráma and Krishna, possessed of glory, flourish as if they were the sole fortresses to the garden which is the excellent town of Kondavídu.
Like the párijáta among celestial trees, like Gándíva (Arjuna) among the five Pándavas, he among them .

cells.object: In front of Chenna Kéšava temple. From line 22 a second inscription begins. The meaning is doubtful in parts
cells.remarks: (1) Hail! During the illustrious Šaka year 1140 Šríman Mahámanđaléšvara Kákatiyya Gaṇapatidéva Mahárájulu, having seen the old inscription and having learnt that the agraháram had been given to Brahmans, gave Dayyálarévúru (Káđivețîi Chitri Kánđa?) situated in Kammanádu. Boundaries are— On the east—Renkulakunta (pond). On the south-east—Bammanipádu and Mrontavikunta (pond). On the south— . . . . river bed. On the south-west—Mandikalakunta (pond). On the west—Baiređdikunta (pond) and north of it Bulumađikunta (pond). On the north-west—Machavárikunta (pond). On the north—Durgamúlakunta (pond). On the north-east—Two ponds. Those who obstruct this will be regarded as having killed 1,000 cows on the Ganges, as having committed murder at Benares and having eaten . . . . from the skull of their eldest sons. (A.D. 1227–28?) (2) Hail! On the year 1149 of the illustrious Šaka era Hail! Šríman Mahámanđaléšvara Mallidéva Chóda Mahárajulu, whose lotus feet are adorned (by the prostrations of) all illustrious rulers of the earth, to wit, the Vilóchana, Trilóchana and others, and who shines like a gem in the family of Karikála who built the dam 1 across the Kávéri, knowing (?) . . . . gave Takkellapádu and old Dayyálarévúru situated in Kammanádu. [One imprecatory verse.] 1 See note on p. 1250 about this.

text.object: In front of Chenna Kéšava temple. From line 22 a second inscription begins. The meaning is doubtful in parts
text.remarks:
(1) Hail! During the illustrious Šaka year 1140 Šríman Mahámanđaléšvara Kákatiyya Gaṇapatidéva Mahárájulu, having seen the old inscription and having learnt that the agraháram had been given to Brahmans, gave Dayyálarévúru (Káđivețîi Chitri Kánđa?) situated in Kammanádu.
Boundaries are—
On the east—Renkulakunta (pond). On the south-east—Bammanipádu and Mrontavikunta (pond).
On the south— . . . . river bed.
On the south-west—Mandikalakunta (pond).
On the west—Baiređdikunta (pond) and north of it Bulumađikunta (pond).
On the north-west—Machavárikunta (pond).
On the north—Durgamúlakunta (pond).
On the north-east—Two ponds.
Those who obstruct this will be regarded as having killed 1,000 cows on the Ganges, as having committed murder at Benares and having eaten . . . . from the skull of their eldest sons.
(A.D. 1227–28?)
(2) Hail! On the year 1149 of the illustrious Šaka era Hail! Šríman Mahámanđaléšvara Mallidéva Chóda Mahárajulu, whose lotus feet are adorned (by the prostrations of) all illustrious rulers of the earth, to wit, the Vilóchana, Trilóchana and others, and who shines like a gem in the family of Karikála who built the dam 1  across the Kávéri, knowing (?) . . . . gave Takkellapádu and old Dayyálarévúru situated in Kammanádu.
[One imprecatory verse.]
1 See note on p. 1250 about this.

cells.object: From stoné against wall of Chennakéšava temple
cells.remarks: May there be prosperity ! Hail ! On Thursday, the 11th of the bright fortnight of Kártika of the year Vijaya, corresponding to the year 1456 of the illustrious, auspicious and prosperous Šáliváhana Šaka era, while Šríman Mahámandaléšvara, Rájádhirája, Rájaparaméšvara, Šrí Vírapratápa Achchutadéva Maháráyulu, seated on the diamond throne at Vijayanagar was ruling the earth, Mallarusayyaváru, the son of Chennékanti Višvanáthayya, of the Šrívatsa gótra , of the Ápastambha sútra and of the Yajus sákha , having performed the consecration and marriage of Kéšavanátha of Chandalúru village which is in Kondavíđu durgam which be (Achchutadéva) was pleased to grant to the prime minister ( mahápradháni ) Bácharusayyaváru and which is in Addanki śima which Bácharusayyaváru was pleased to grant to us, for providing decorations and sacred food for the deity, granted with libation of water and aksha (consecrated rice) lands to the south of the village Chandalúru, to the east of Rávinútalapáđu tank, to the east of the village . . . . and also one putṭi . . . . of lands . . . . in Késaripáđu. Therefore let the deity be pleased to enjoy the produce thereof in perpetuity as long as the sun and moon last. [One imprecatory verse.] . Srí ! We have granted a field of one kuchchela as a sarra-mányam to Káśivírabhaktu, who performed the above ceremonies. Who have granted a field of 2 kuchchalas to Tirumalu Sarva Sánindási, the dancing girls of the Tiruvíthi sacred street, who óo service to this deity. Let them therefore enjoy it in perpetuity as long as the sun and moon endure and live happily. Those who violate this charity will be regarded as having killed cows and Brahmans. Śrí!
cells.text_original:
1. శుభమస్తు ॥ స్వస్తి శ్రీ శుభశాసనాభ్యదయ శాలివా
2. హన శకవర్ణంబులు ౧౮౫౬ అగు నేంటి విజయ
3. సంవత్సర కార్తిక బింగ గు శ్రీమత్తవో మండలే
4. శ్వర రాజాధిరాజ రాజ వర షేశ్వర శ్రీపీర వ్ర
5. తావ అచ్చుతదేవ గూహారాయులుంగారు విజయ
6. నగరమందు వజ్రసింహ్యసనా రూఢులై స్ప
7. థ్వి రాజ్యం శేయుచుండ శ్రీమహావ్రథానులైన
8. బాచరుసయ్యవారిః! పాలించ్చయీ నవధరించ్చి
9. న కొండపిటి దుర్గంలోని బాచరుసయ్యవారు
10. మాకు యీ నవధరించిన అందంకి శీమలోని
11. చందలూరిగ్రామం కేశవనాధ్గ వివాహ వ్రతిష్టతే
12. శి దేవునికి అంగ్గరంగ్గ వైభవాలకున్న అమృతవక్ష
13. కున్న శ్రీవత్సగోత్రం ఆవస్త్యంభసూత్రం యజిశా
14. ఖాద్యాయులైన బెన్నేకంటి విశ్వనాధయ్య కొమాల్ల
15. మల్లరుసయ్యవారు చందలూరిపొలాన ఇచ్చిన త్రేత్రం
16. గ్రామం దక్షిణపుదికుగాన రావినూంతులచెరువుకు తూ
ప్పుడ
17. నాను వూరితూష్టునాను కూడాను కేసరిపాటిని త్రే త్రం ౪౦ అట్ొ
18. దక ధారాపూవకముగాను ఇస్తిమిగాన అందుఫలం ఆచ
19. ంద్రాక్క న్థాభిగాను అనుభవించి ఆవధరించుడి! దాన పాల న
20. యోమక ధ్యే దానా చ్ఛే యోను పాలన । దానాస్వగ్గ మవాప్నే తి పా
21. లనా దచ్యుతంపదం॥ శ్రీ॥ వుభయపనులను కీశిన కాశీ పి
22. రాభక్తునికి వొకకుచ్చెలచేను సర్వమాన్యంగాను ఇస్తిమి॥
23. యీదేవుని శావశేశే తిరువీధిసాంస్లు తిరుమలు సవక
24. సానిందాశికి ౨ రెండుకుచ్చట్ల చేనుయి స్తివిగాన ఆచం చ్రా
25. కకన్థాయిగాను అనుభవించి బితు కేది । యాధర్మానకుం దప్పి
26. నవారు గో బాగ్రిహ్మనికించంప్పినవారు॥ శ్రీ ॥

text.text_original: 1. శుభమస్తు ॥ స్వస్తి శ్రీ శుభశాసనాభ్యదయ శాలివా2. హన శకవర్ణంబులు ౧౮౫౬ అగు నేంటి విజయ3. సంవత్సర కార్తిక బింగ గు శ్రీమత్తవో మండలే4. శ్వర రాజాధిరాజ రాజ వర షేశ్వర శ్రీపీర వ్ర5. తావ అచ్చుతదేవ గూహారాయులుంగారు విజయ6. నగరమందు వజ్రసింహ్యసనా రూఢులై స్ప7. థ్వి రాజ్యం శేయుచుండ శ్రీమహావ్రథానులైన8. బాచరుసయ్యవారిః! పాలించ్చయీ నవధరించ్చి9. న కొండపిటి దుర్గంలోని బాచరుసయ్యవారు10. మాకు యీ నవధరించిన అందంకి శీమలోని11. చందలూరిగ్రామం కేశవనాధ్గ వివాహ వ్రతిష్టతే12. శి దేవునికి అంగ్గరంగ్గ వైభవాలకున్న అమృతవక్ష13. కున్న శ్రీవత్సగోత్రం ఆవస్త్యంభసూత్రం యజిశా14. ఖాద్యాయులైన బెన్నేకంటి విశ్వనాధయ్య కొమాల్ల15. మల్లరుసయ్యవారు చందలూరిపొలాన ఇచ్చిన త్రేత్రం16. గ్రామం దక్షిణపుదికుగాన రావినూంతులచెరువుకు తూప్పుడ17. నాను వూరితూష్టునాను కూడాను కేసరిపాటిని త్రే త్రం ౪౦ అట్ొ18. దక ధారాపూవకముగాను ఇస్తిమిగాన అందుఫలం ఆచ19. ంద్రాక్క న్థాభిగాను అనుభవించి ఆవధరించుడి! దాన పాల న20. యోమక ధ్యే దానా చ్ఛే యోను పాలన । దానాస్వగ్గ మవాప్నే తి పా21. లనా దచ్యుతంపదం॥ శ్రీ॥ వుభయపనులను కీశిన కాశీ పి22. రాభక్తునికి వొకకుచ్చెలచేను సర్వమాన్యంగాను ఇస్తిమి॥23. యీదేవుని శావశేశే తిరువీధిసాంస్లు తిరుమలు సవక24. సానిందాశికి ౨ రెండుకుచ్చట్ల చేనుయి స్తివిగాన ఆచం చ్రా25. కకన్థాయిగాను అనుభవించి బితు కేది । యాధర్మానకుం దప్పి26. నవారు గో బాగ్రిహ్మనికించంప్పినవారు॥ శ్రీ ॥

cells.object: From two sides of a stone opposite Rámálinga temple
cells.remarks: Hail! On Sunday, the 7th of the bright fortnight of Vaiśákha, corresponding to the Śaka year 1175, while Srímau Mahámandalésvara Kákatiya Ganapatidéva Mahárázulu, who is entitled to the five great (musical) sounds, who is Mahámandalésvara, who is a great devotee of Śiva, who is filled with good will towards others, who is adorned with humility, who is the excellent lord of the city of Anumakonda, who is the worshipper of the illustrious lotus feet of Srí Svayambhudéva, and who is the vanquisher of hostile armies, was ruling the earth, his feudatory (Hail !) Srí Mandalésvara Chakra Náráyana Srí Singadéva Mahárájuiu, who is possessed of all eulogistic titles, who is a Révanta amongst those who ride very unruly horses, who is death to hostile armies, who is a fortress of adamant to his refugees, who is the protector of life, and who is a hero without fear, makes a gift of the following, for securing prosperity. Vritti for the pújári measured with a pole of 12 fathoms. For Padmajiyya and Dévajiyya 250 kuntas . For decorations and enjoyments to the deity a field of 2,000 kuntas . May it cause great prosperity ! Out of that land, 60 kuntas are for Ekásedámója, 100 kuntas for Mélunáyaninúnkayya and one ma for the lamp of the deity. The sun and moon, wind, heaven, earth, water . . . . Yama, day and night, the two Sandhyas and Dharma, know the mind of man. [One imprecatory verse.] ONGOLE (23-A). (A.D. 1166-67.) [Chandrapádu. Telugu. In front of Śiva temple.] Hail ! On Tuesday the 15th of dark half of Márgaśira of the year Vyaya, corresponding to the illustrious Śaka year 1089, on account of a solar eclipse, Kondapa Náyakundu owner of (?) Chandrúru on the bank of the Gunđđi river, who is the dutiful son of Erramanáyaka, who is like the moon (Sudhákara) to the ocean of the Manumapála family, who declares the good properties of Mahéṣvara, and who bends his head to the lotus feet of his own guru (priest), gave 55 she-goats to Srí Nágéṣvaramahádéva of Chandrúru for a perpetual light. Rabbena Śetṭi, son of Nangaréku Naḍvi Śetṭi, should receive these and maintain the grant. He, his sons and grandsons should give for the lamp every day one mánika of ghee as long as the sun and moon exist. This charity will continue as long as the earth exists. Thanks to Ganéśa. Three puttis of land were given to Srí Nágéṣvara Mahádéva.

text.object: From two sides of a stone opposite Rámálinga temple
text.remarks:
Hail! On Sunday, the 7th of the bright fortnight of Vaiśákha, corresponding to the Śaka year 1175, while Srímau Mahámandalésvara Kákatiya Ganapatidéva Mahárázulu, who is entitled to the five great (musical) sounds, who is Mahámandalésvara, who is a great devotee of Śiva, who is filled with good will towards others, who is adorned with humility, who is the excellent lord of the city of Anumakonda, who is the worshipper of the illustrious lotus feet of Srí Svayambhudéva, and who is the vanquisher of hostile armies, was ruling the earth, his feudatory (Hail !) Srí Mandalésvara Chakra Náráyana Srí Singadéva Mahárájuiu, who is possessed of all eulogistic titles, who is a Révanta amongst those who ride very unruly horses, who is death to hostile armies, who is a fortress of adamant to his refugees, who is the protector of life, and who is a hero without fear, makes a gift of the following, for securing prosperity.
Vritti  for the  pújári  measured with a pole of 12 fathoms. For Padmajiyya and Dévajiyya 250  kuntas . For decorations and enjoyments to the deity a field of 2,000  kuntas . May it cause great prosperity !
Out of that land, 60  kuntas  are for Ekásedámója, 100  kuntas  for Mélunáyaninúnkayya and one  ma  for the lamp of the deity. The sun and moon, wind, heaven, earth, water . . . . Yama, day and night, the two Sandhyas and Dharma, know the mind of man.
[One imprecatory verse.]
ONGOLE (23-A). (A.D. 1166-67.)
[Chandrapádu. Telugu. In front of Śiva temple.]
Hail ! On Tuesday the 15th of dark half of Márgaśira of the year Vyaya, corresponding to the illustrious Śaka year 1089, on account of a solar eclipse, Kondapa Náyakundu owner of (?) Chandrúru on the bank of the Gunđđi river, who is the dutiful son of Erramanáyaka, who is like the moon (Sudhákara) to the ocean of the Manumapála family, who declares the good properties of Mahéṣvara, and who bends his head to the lotus feet of his own guru (priest), gave 55 she-goats to Srí Nágéṣvaramahádéva of Chandrúru for a perpetual light. Rabbena Śetṭi, son of Nangaréku Naḍvi Śetṭi, should receive these and maintain the grant. He, his sons and grandsons should give for the lamp every day one mánika of ghee as long as the sun and moon exist. This charity will continue as long as the earth exists. Thanks to Ganéśa. Three  puttis  of land were given to Srí Nágéṣvara Mahádéva.

cells.object: On Kalyánamandapam
cells.remarks: Salutations be to Rámachandra. Hail! On Thursday, the 11th of the bright fortnight of Ásháđha of the year Kródhana, corresponding to the year 1488 of the illustrious, victorious and prosperous Śáliváhana Śaka era, while Śríman Mahárájádhirája Rájaparaméšvara Śrí Vírapratápa Sadáśivadéva Maháráyalu was ruling the kingdom of the earth, in the kingdom ( rájya ) of Koṇdavíđu which he granted to Śríman Mahámaṇdaléšvara Ráma Rájayaran Tirumala Rájayya Déva Mahárájulungáru, in Koṇdavíđu rájya which he was pleased to grant to Śríman Mahámaṇdaléšvara Siddhiráju Rangaparájayyadéva Mahárájulungáru, in Addanki Ammanabrólu śima , to Śrí Raghunáyakulu of Chaduluváđa; Rangapa Rájayyadéva Mahárájulungáru, the great grandson of Siddhirájungáru, the grandson of Vóbularájungáru, the son of Timmaráju, presented on the holy occasion of the first ekádasi (eleventh day of the lunar fortnight) with libation of water and gift of gold to Śrí Raghunáyakulu of Chadaluváđa the income derived from the addagada sunkam 1 and katnālu (presents) (?) in Chadaluváda, Mallavaram, Alavalapádu, and other villages, the sunkam from the bharitas (residents ?) of the sthala , and the múlavisálubađi 2 and other taxes. Therefore Rangapárájayyagáru, the grandson of (as before) with a devout heart presented this charity to Srí Raghunáyakulu of Chadaluváda. Therefore it should be maintained in perpetuity as long as the sun and moon endure. [Three imprecatory verses.] Srí! Srí! NOT.—There is a lot of repetition in this inscription. The reference to the two grantees of the Konḍavīdu rájyam is not understood.

Salutations be to Rámachandra.
Hail! On Thursday, the 11th of the bright fortnight of Ásháđha of the year Kródhana, corresponding to the year 1488 of the illustrious, victorious and prosperous Śáliváhana Śaka era, while Śríman Mahárájádhirája Rájaparaméšvara Śrí Vírapratápa Sadáśivadéva Maháráyalu was ruling the kingdom of the earth, in the kingdom ( rájya ) of Koṇdavíđu which he granted to Śríman Mahámaṇdaléšvara Ráma Rájayaran Tirumala Rájayya Déva Mahárájulungáru, in Koṇdavíđu  rájya  which he was pleased to grant to Śríman Mahámaṇdaléšvara Siddhiráju Rangaparájayyadéva Mahárájulungáru, in Addanki Ammanabrólu  śima , to Śrí Raghunáyakulu of Chaduluváđa; Rangapa Rájayyadéva Mahárájulungáru, the great grandson of Siddhirájungáru, the grandson of Vóbularájungáru, the son of Timmaráju, presented on the holy occasion of the first  ekádasi  (eleventh day of the lunar fortnight) with libation of water and gift of gold to Śrí Raghunáyakulu of Chadaluváđa the income derived from the  addagada sunkam  1  and  katnālu  (presents) (?) in Chadaluváda, Mallavaram, Alavalapádu, and other villages, the  sunkam  from the  bharitas  (residents ?) of the  sthala , and the  múlavisálubađi  2  and other taxes. Therefore Rangapárájayyagáru, the grandson of (as before) with a devout heart presented this charity to Srí Raghunáyakulu of Chadaluváda. Therefore it should be maintained in perpetuity as long as the sun and moon endure.
[Three imprecatory verses.]
Srí! Srí!
NOT.—There is a lot of repetition in this inscription. The reference to the two grantees of the Konḍavīdu rájyam is not understood.

cells.remarks: Hail to Rámachandráya! cells.object: In front of Raghunáyaka temple
cells.remarks: Salutations be to Śrí Rámachandra. Hail! The following are the particulars of an inscribed pillar planted in Chadalaváđa sthala in Ammanabrólu śima for the religious merit of Śiddhiráju Timmarájayya by Mandapáti Appala Ráju on the 15th of the bright fortnight of Phálguna of the year Kálayukti, corresponding to the Śrí Śaka year 1481, while Śrímat Rájadéva Rája Rájaparamésvara Śrí Vírapratápa Śrí Sadásivadéva Ráyulu, seated on the jewelled throne at Vijayanagar, was ruling the kingdom of the earth, while Śrímán Mahámaṇḍalésvara Śiddhi Ráju Timmarájayyadéva Mahárájulu was ruling over Konđavíđu. We have presented to Śrí Raghunáyakulu the taxes levied on articles sold in Chadalaváđa village, the sthala of Raghunáyakulu, and on grain, the adagada sunkham , the múlavisálu collected in Addanki and Ammanabrólu śimas , and the sunkham and the old kaṭnam collected in Śrí Raghunáyakulu sthala . Therefore the temple people themselves should credit the taxes to the estate of Śrí Raghunáyakulu and grant receipts to the merchants who buy there and receipts for the taxes raised in the two śimas . For the daily offerings to Raghunáyakulu we have remitted the taxes levied on paddy and other articles bought in Konđavíđu śima , on paddy and other articles purchased and brought during festivals, on articles brought for sale by merchants during festivals, on articles purchased and taken away by merchants during festivals, and the fees collected in Addanki and Ammanabrólu símas . We have remitted the Randintappulári (?) from the time of hoisting of the flag during festivals and big festivals up to the 30th of Phálguna. Those who henceforth do not maintain this but violate it, will incur the sin of killing a cow and a Brahman near the Ganges. [One imprecatory verse.]

text.object: In front of Raghunáyaka temple
text.remarks:
Salutations be to Śrí Rámachandra.
Hail! The following are the particulars of an inscribed pillar planted in Chadalaváđa  sthala  in Ammanabrólu  śima  for the religious merit of Śiddhiráju Timmarájayya by Mandapáti Appala Ráju on the 15th of the bright fortnight of Phálguna of the year Kálayukti, corresponding to the Śrí Śaka year 1481, while Śrímat Rájadéva Rája Rájaparamésvara Śrí Vírapratápa Śrí Sadásivadéva Ráyulu, seated on the jewelled throne at Vijayanagar, was ruling the kingdom of the earth, while Śrímán Mahámaṇḍalésvara Śiddhi Ráju Timmarájayyadéva Mahárájulu was ruling over Konđavíđu. We have presented to Śrí Raghunáyakulu the taxes levied on articles sold in Chadalaváđa village, the  sthala  of Raghunáyakulu, and on grain, the  adagada sunkham , the  múlavisálu  collected in Addanki and Ammanabrólu  śimas , and the  sunkham  and the old  kaṭnam  collected in Śrí Raghunáyakulu  sthala . Therefore the temple people themselves should credit the taxes to the estate of Śrí Raghunáyakulu and grant receipts to the merchants who buy there and receipts for the taxes raised in the two  śimas . For the daily offerings to Raghunáyakulu we have remitted the taxes levied on paddy and other articles bought in Konđavíđu  śima , on paddy and other articles purchased and brought during festivals, on articles brought for sale by merchants during festivals, on articles purchased and taken away by merchants during festivals, and the fees collected in Addanki and Ammanabrólu  símas . We have remitted the  Randintappulári (?) from the time of hoisting of the flag during festivals and big festivals up to the 30th of Phálguna.
Those who henceforth do not maintain this but violate it, will incur the sin of killing a cow and a Brahman near the Ganges.
[One imprecatory verse.]

text.object: To south of Chennakéšava temple
text.remarks: Hail! On the 10th of the bright fortnight of Ásháđha in the year Paridhávi, corresponding to the illustrious, victorious and prosperous Šáliváhana Šaka year . . . . the (following) charitable edict was granted by Rámanáyaningáru after making innumerable salutations to the lotus feet of Śrí Chéjarla Kéšavadéva (and) to Rávi Parákéšamáryara. In the south-western quarter of Pina Chéjarla in Ammanabrólu  síma  granted to us by Dévarájayyaváru, I have presented land under the tank for the daily offerings, lights, and all enjoyments of the deity. I have also given two  putṭis  of land under the tank as a  sarvamánya  . . . . The grazing fee levied on this field . . . . for the daily offerings . . . . and all enjoyments . . . .

cells.object: Opposite Vénugópálaswámi temple
cells.remarks: Hail! On Thursday, the 11th of the bright fortnight of Áshádha of the year Bahudhánya, corresponding to the illustrious Śaka year 1260, this charitable edict was granted to Dhénuvukonda Gópálakṛishna by Poddilapalli Śingamanáyanimgáru after making obeisance. Whoever violates this charity will incur the sin of killing a cow on the banks of the Ganges. [One imprecatory verse.] NOT.—This Singama does not appear elsewhere in our collection. cells.object: By a path to the east
cells.remarks: Hail! On Thursday, the 30th of the dark fortnight of Kártika of the year Sarvadhári, corresponding to the illustrious and prosperous Śaka year 1450, on the holy occasion of a solar eclipse, in the lands which Pángula Chumpiri presented with prostrations to Mallikárjuna-déva of Vúrudoddáram (Doddavaram village) in Ammana-brólu śma , he has given two túms of land in Késaripádu, viz., the field Gándakatṭachénu, lying in the north, near Gađeyana street for the sacred food ( amritapađi ) of the deity. [Imprecatory verses.]

cells.object: To the east in a tope; from three sides of a stone
cells.remarks: On Monday, the 3rd of the bright fortnight of Bhádrapada of the year Sarvadhári, this charitable edict was granted by Pongula Mitinénigáru after máking obeisance to Vináyaka (Ganésa) of Doddavaram. The mányam bought from Mádani Venkusáni (is given) for worship with a light (?) We gave formerly (?) the eastern field to Venkaṭayya. Therefore he should enjoy it as long as the moon and sun endure. [Four imprecatory verses.]
cells.text_original:
1. సర్వదారి సంవత్సర బాద
2. వద శు 3 సో | దొడ్డవరం
3. వినాయ
4. కునికి పొంగులమితి నేనింగారు దం
5. డ్డం వెట్టి యిచ్చిన ధక్కుణాసనం
6. ము | మా
7. దనివెంకుసాని వచ్చి దొడ్డటికొన్నమాన్యం దీ
8. పారాద్యాలకు తూవ్వుపాలం వెంకట
9. య్యను పూర్వకం చెల్లింసె స్తిమిగాన ఆదంద్రా
10. రకంగాను అనుభవించువాండ్రు | స్వదత్తా ద్విగుణం
11. ప్రణ్యం పరదత్తానుపాలనం వరదత్తావహారేణ స్వ
12. దత్త నివ్వలంభవేతు | ఏకైవ భగినిలాణికే సర్వేషా
మేవభూబుజాం
13. నళోజ్యా నకరగ్రాంహ్య విప్రదత్తా వసుంధరా | స్వద
త్తాం
14. వరదత్తాం వాయోహ రేతివమంధరాం పప్పివ్వావ్వా సేవ స్రాణి
15. విష్టాయాం జాయ త్రేకిమిః | మద్వశజాః పరమహీపతి
16. వంశజావాయే భూమిపాః సతత ముజ్వలధర్మచిత్తామద్ధ క్షమేవ
17. సతతంపరిపాఠయంతు త్వత్పాదుకాద్వయమనాం సిర పావహా
18. మి॥

cells.object: To west of Káśiviṣvéṣvara temple
cells.remarks: Hail! On Wednesday, the 11th of the bright fortnight of Kártika of the year Bahudhánya, corresponding to the year 1140 of the illustrious Śaka era, Śrímat Súryagiri Dandanáyaka Chandra set up the image of Śrí Chandréṣvara Mahádéva naming it after himself in Mánópalli otherwise called Batṭirrapaṭtam, which is on the coast of the eastern sea in Kammanádu for the religious merit of Śrímat Gaṇapatidéva Mahárája. He constructed a temple along with an illustrious mandapa and granted in perpetuity, to last as the sun and mood endure, Erra Cherugonasapúndi for providing all enjoyments to Śrí Chandćśvara Śrí Mahádéva, for the religious merit of Ganapatidéva Mahárája. [One imprecatory verse.]
cells.text_original:
1. స్వస్తిశ్రీ శకవరుషంబులు
2. ౧౧౪౦ యగు సేంటిబహు
3. ధాంస్య సంవత్సర శాబ్దిక శు
4. ద్వవక ౧౧ యుర బుధవాం
5. బునం గంమనాంటిలోనం
6. బూవ్వక సముద్రతీరంబున (బట్టి
7. (ర) వట్టణంబైన మానోవల్లియ
8. ందు నిజనామాంకితంబుగా
9. శ్రీచంద్రేశ్వర శ్రీమహాదేవుని శ్రీ
10. మతు గణవతి దేవమహారా
11. జులకు ధమువుగా బ్రతిష్టిం
12. చెను శ్రీమండవ సమన్వితం
13. బుగాగుడి ఎస్తించి శ్రీషత్పుయ్యక
14. ౧8 దండనాయక చంద్రం
15. థు శ్రీచంద్రేశ్వర శ్రీమహాదేవు
16. నికి అంగరంగ భోగంబుల
17. కు ఎఱ్ఱచెఱుగొన సప్తాండి
18. ని చంద్రాకర్ణాస్తాయిగా గణవతిదే
19. వ మహారాజులకు ధమువుగాని
20. నిస్థిమి దీనికి స్వదత్తాం వరదత్తాం
21. వాయో హారేతి వసుంధరా
22. వష్టీవ్వకు సహస్రాణి విష్టా
23. యాం జాయతేక్రిమి॥

cells.object: In front of Vírabhadraswámi temple
cells.remarks: Hail! On the holy occasion on Tuesday, the 11th of the bright half of Kártika of the year Pramódúta, corresponding to the year 1433 of the illustrious, victorious and prosperous Šaliváhana Šaka era, while Šríman Mahámanđalésvara Rájádhi Rája Rájaparamésvara Rája Téjónidhi (treasury of splendour) Šrí Krishnadéva Maháráyulu was ruling the kingdom of the earth, Súrnáyani Abbánáyaniváru was pleased to give Gónugunta,' attached to Kocharlakota Kataka in Ammanabrolu śima which Sáluva Timmarasayya was pleased to give to Súrnáyani Abbánáyaniváru and which is situated in Konđavíđu rájya which was given to him (Timmaru-sayya) by the Rája, for the religious merit of Timmaru-suváru for providing amritapađi to Amarésvara of Gonugunta which is subject to him (Abbanáyaniváru). . . . . on the west, Gonugunta, the western extremity . . . . on the east of . . . . the méra grain realized from the amaram , on the north of the village . . . . on the west of the tank, on the east of Yélumnáđu, on the south of Sévúru, near Chellikúru . . . . to . . . Vórungirammakúr . . . at the junction of that field and Gonugunta . . . the field granted putți , per putți . . . to the village . . . to the west of mádigalachénu to the south of the village, the mányam to the east . . . torikump . . . . shall belong to Amarasvara . . . Those who violate this will incur the sin of killing cows and Brahmans near the Ganges. If any one obstruct and do not give (méras) he will incur in perpetuity as long as the sun and moon endure the sin of eating from the skull of his eldest son, and of killing cows, and his parents. [One imprecatory verse.] (2) On the gópuram of the temple of Rámalingésvara at Gonugunṭa there is a long inscription describing a grant made by a zamindar of Venkaṭagiri to the temple. It is probably modern and is of no interest. . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .
cells.text_original:
1. స్వస్తిత్రీ జయాభ్యుదయ శాలివాహన శకవర్షంబులు ౧౮౩౩ అగు సేంటి బ్రహ్మాదూ
2. త సంవత్సర కాస్తిక భువ్ధ ౧౧ మంవార ప్రణ్యకాల మందున శ్రీ మన్నకు మండలేశ్వర రాజా
3. ధి రాజ రాజ పరమేశ్వర రాజతేజోనిధి శ్రీ కృష్ణదేవ మహారాయులు వృశివీరాజ్యము తే
4. యుచును సాళువతింమరసయ్యరువారికి దయచేసి యి య్యంగా నంగరంగ వైభవాలతో
5. ను రాజ్యముతేయుచును తిమరసయ్యవారు తమకు చెల్లి వచ్చె కొండవీడురాశ్యం
6. లోను స్వానాయని అబ్బానాయనివారిగు దయచేసి యిచ్చిన అమ్మనబోలు సిమలోను కొచ్చలక
7. కోటకటక సాలుంగపట్టునగోనుగుంటన స్వానాయని అబ్బానాయనివారు దయచేసి
8. తిమ్మరుసువారికి ప్రణ్యముగాను తమకతేసే దమకు జెల్లివచ్చెడి గోనుగుంటను ఆమరేశ్వర
9. దేవునకు ఆమృతవళ్లములకు . . . . వడ మటను గొనుగుంట వడమటి కొమ్మున . . .
10. . యణిరి వూరికి తూప్పుణనను అమరానకువచ్చె మేర వంటను వూరికి వుత్తరమునను . . .
11. చెరువు వడమటను యెలుంనాటికి వూర్వానానం [శేవూరికి దక్షిణము తట్టునను చెల్లి కూరివద్ద]

text.object: In front of Vírabhadraswámi temple
text.remarks:
Hail! On the holy occasion on Tuesday, the 11th of the bright half of Kártika of the year Pramódúta, corresponding to the year 1433 of the illustrious, victorious and prosperous Šaliváhana Šaka era, while Šríman Mahámanđalésvara Rájádhi Rája Rájaparamésvara Rája Téjónidhi (treasury of splendour) Šrí Krishnadéva Maháráyulu was ruling the kingdom of the earth, Súrnáyani Abbánáyaniváru was pleased to give Gónugunta,' attached to Kocharlakota  Kataka  in Ammanabrolu  śima  which Sáluva Timmarasayya was pleased to give to Súrnáyani Abbánáyaniváru and which is situated in Konđavíđu  rájya  which was given to him (Timmaru-sayya) by the Rája, for the religious merit of Timmaru-suváru for providing  amritapađi  to Amarésvara of Gonugunta which is subject to him (Abbanáyaniváru).
. . . . on the west, Gonugunta, the western extremity . . . . on the east of . . . . the  méra  grain realized from the  amaram , on the north of the village . . . . on the west of the tank, on the east of Yélumnáđu, on the south of Sévúru, near Chellikúru . . . . to . . . Vórungirammakúr . . . at the junction of that field and Gonugunta . . . the field granted  putți , per  putți  . . . to the village . . . to the west of mádigalachénu to the south of the village, the  mányam  to the east . . . torikump . . . . shall belong to Amarasvara . . . Those who violate this will incur the sin of killing cows and Brahmans near the Ganges. If any one obstruct and do not give (méras) he will incur in perpetuity as long as the sun and moon endure the sin of eating from the skull of his eldest son, and of killing cows, and his parents.
[One imprecatory verse.]
(2) On the gópuram of the temple of Rámalingésvara at Gonugunṭa there is a long inscription describing a grant made by a zamindar of Venkaṭagiri to the temple. It is probably modern and is of no interest.
. . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .

cells.object: Stone in enclosure of Bhíméśvara temple
cells.remarks: Hail! In the year Bháva, corresponding to the Srí Saka year 1076 on the occasion of a solar eclipse, we, Sríman Mahásámanta (provincial chief) Viyavéláru have given with libation of water ten matlu of land in our village Pangalúru, situated in Kammanádu for providing oblation, a sacrifice and worship to the great deity Tiruvengalabha. [Two imprecatory verses.] Whoever obstructs this will be regarded as having killed 1,500 tawny cows on the banks of the Ganges, as having eaten from the skull of his eldest son, and as having killed at Benares.

1. స్వప్తి శ్రీమతు సకవరువములు ౧౦౭౬ అ

5. గులూరు హవిఐలి అచ్చకనలకు సూయక గ్ర
6. హణ నిమి త్రమునం వ గం మట్లు భూమి
7. దారా పూవ్వకముసేసి ఇచ్చితిమి | ఐహుభి
8. వ్వక నుధాదత్తా ఐహుభివ్వాణసు పాలితం యెస్యయె
స్యయె
9. దా భూమితస్యత స్యదదాఖలం | స్వదత్తం వర
10. దత్తాం వాయ్యాహరేతి వనుంభరా షట్టివ్వరుష
11. సహస్ర్రాణి మిష్టాయాం జాయతేక్రిమి | దీని
12. నెక్వరేని విలమముసేనినవారు ౧౦౧ క
13. ఱుత ౧౫౦౦ ౧విలల షఫించినవారు

15. నవారు || బాణరాణి వ్రచ్చినవారు||
cells.notes: NOTE.—Perhaps Vijavéláru of 50 is the same as Jiyyaru of 51. There is probably some mistake about the name which does not seem to appear elsewhere. Perhaps we should read Vijaya instead of Vija and Jiyyaru.

4. శ్వియుజ బహుల బాడ్యమి నాదివారము వేశి
5. వకముణ్ణులు శ్రీమద్రాజ రాజ దేవర దివ్యశ్రీ
6. పాద శ్రేవశా భయదాయమాన మహాసామంత

8. గుడిమణియమునగు బ్రెలమాన్యం ఇచ్చితిమిదియాచంద్రా కకతా

10. వారు మూలస్థానపతి వీరజియ్యల కొడకు సేతజియ్య
11. లు ఈ గుడియిని మండవమును గుట్టించి నిత్య నివేద్యము
12. దీవము నడపంగలవాండు ఇస్థానాపతిని దస్తినైవ్వరేని జెట్టి
13. నవారు గంగక ఆ్రం గవిలంవధించినవారు బహుభివక ను ధాద
14. త్ర బహు ఖచ్చానుపాలితా యెస్యయెస్య యదాఖూమి తస్య తస్యయదా

16. స్రాణి విష్టాయాం జాయతే క్రిమి॥

cells.object: Stone to east of Bhíméṣvara temple
cells.remarks: Hail! On Monday, the 14th of the dark fortnight of Mágha of the year Ángírasa, corresponding to the illustrious, victorious and prosperous Śáliváhana Saka year 1554, this charitable edict of land was caused to be granted by Mudupali Tirumalayya, the agent (káryakarta) of Śrí Veligóti Komára Timmánáyaniváru, after making endless salutations to the great god Bhíméṣvara of the illustrious Pangulúru. On this holy occasion of Śivarátri we have given with libation of water for the religious merit of Kumára Timmánáyanigáru, the Lingagunta field of two gorrus as an entire inám in the Nesaripáti Kuchela field having on the north the path to Chandalúru and the boundary line of Chandalúru on the east and Góparázuváru waste land on the south and Góparájuváru field on the west. Therefore . . . . these two gorrus of land with the eight kinds of ownership and powers . . . .
cells.text_original:
1. స్వప్తి శ్రీ జయాబ్యుదయ శాలివాహనశక వ
2. మఱంబ్బులు || ౧౫౫౮ || అగునెంటి ఆంగ్లీర (స) సం
3. వ్వత్సర మాఘ ఐ ౧౮ సో శ్రీమతు వంగ్లులూరి భీ
4. మేశ్వర శ్రీమహాదేవునిట శ్రీవెలిగోటి కొమా
5. రతిమ్మనాభినివారి కార్యక త్త్వలై నముడువలి తిరు
6. మలయ్య అనంతములైన దండ్లములు సమప్పించి యి
7. ప్పించిన భూదాన ధమ్మశాసనది ఇసివరాత్రి పుణ్యకాల
మంధ్ర స్వా
8. మి అంగ్ల రంగబోగములకుంటానునె సరిపాటకుచ్చిలక్షే త్రము రెండు
9. గోల్లచేను లింగ్లికుంటచేను వుల్తారాన్ను చందలూరి దోవాను తూవ్వులు
10. న చెంద్దలూరి పొలిమేరానున్ను దక్షిణాను గోవరాజు వారి బీడును
11. వడువుట గోవరాజువారి చేనునున్ను . ఇలాోనను . సవ్వమాన్యం
12. గాను . . కుమారతిమ్మనాయినింగారి- పుణ్యంగాను ధారాపోసి ఇస్తిమిగానయీ
13. రెండుగోల్ల . . . చెను అందుగల అక్షభాగ తేజ స్వామ్యము ఆ

cells.object: From four sides of a stone opposite Gokanésvara temple
cells.remarks: Hail ! On Monday, the 1st of the bright fortnight of Chaitra of the year Vijaya, corresponding to the illustrious Śaka year 1215, Hail ! while Śríman Mahámandalésvara Kákatíya Pratápa Rudradéva Mahárája was ruling and holding pleasant intercourse (with his feudatories), mányams were given to Polamara sthána constructed for Brahma (?), vrittis to god and Brahmans and a field up to its four boundaries(?) . . . Báhata Dévarája caused the village . . . . to be given as charity to Bhímésvara Śrí Mahádévara (whose image is) set up at Rávinútula for his enjoyment as long as sun and moon SIONE INSCRIPTIONS, exist for the religious merit of his ruler Rudradéva Mahárája. cells.object: From stone removed from above the gate of the Vishnu temple
cells.remarks: V. 1. In the illustrious Śaka year, reckoned by the elephant (8), the oceans (4), the fires (3), and the mooa (1), i.e. , 1348, on the 11th tithi of the bright fortnight of Mágha in the year Bhava preceded by Para (Parábhava), there was a holy city called Kóśámbika, which is situated at the junction of the Brahmakunđi (Gundlakamma) with the sea, at a distance of yójanas reckoned by the eyes (2) and the moon (1), i.e. , 12, to the east of Śrísáila, and which was the abode of 1,000 linguas. V. 2. King Víra Amala (Abala), of great valour, scion of the solar race, son of king Núnka, being entreated by kings who were his equals “Be our refuge” gave to the pious Brahmans, whose conduct was pure and approved by the védas, and who were enjoying lands given by him in that town, wealth consisting of the eight species of property and the eight species of enjoyment to last as long as the sun and moon endure. Kósambika = gold. Kósambikapuri = city of gold, Kanakapuri a Sanskritized form of Kanuparti. Inscriptions (55) and (56) are of the same date and the donors' fathers seem to be the same. But the stone is rough and the inscriptions had to be read in situ and there may be some mistakes. Kanuparti contains a large number of lingams even now.
